  • Quarterly Socials
  • Volunteer Days to give back to our community

Compensation Disclosure The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $190,000 CAD, plus performance bonus. This is a net-new position on the team. Final compensation depends on experience and qualifications. Please note that base salary ranges may differ based on location and local currency.

AI Disclosure: We use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence, to support parts of our recruitment process (such as resume screening, note taking, and interview scheduling). These tools are designed to support, but never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by humans, and we are committed to fair, inclusive, and bias-aware hiring practices.

DEI : At Paramount Commerce, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. We practice ethical and fair hiring processes and strongly encourage applications from diverse backgrounds. We believe that different perspectives, experiences, backgrounds, and skill sets are what make for high performing teams, and we are committed to creating a place for our employees to be their authentic selves. Don't worry if you don't check every box. If you're excited about this role and think you'd be a good fit, we encourage you to apply.

À propos de Paramount Commerce

Nous sommes Paramount Commerce, une entreprise de technologie financière de premier plan qui simplifie les paiements au Canada depuis le début des années 2000. Nous traitons annuellement 5 milliards de dollars pour certaines des plus grandes plateformes de jeux et de cryptomonnaies au monde, via les réseaux Interac, TEF et bientôt RTR (temps réel). Notre infrastructure est au cœur de la circulation monétaire au Canada.

Alors que nous nous déployons dans de nouveaux secteurs verticaux et préparons notre expansion mondiale, la complexité de nos produits dépasse notre façon de les vendre. Nos solutions couvrent de multiples réseaux, modèles de règlement et cadres réglementaires. Les marchands qui les achètent sont de plus en plus sophistiqués; ils disposent de leurs propres ingénieurs de paiement et équipes produits qui s'attendent à avoir un homologue technique à la table de discussion. Aujourd'hui, cet homologue n'existe pas en tant que fonction dédiée. Cela est sur le point de changer.

L'Opportunité

Relevant directement du Chef des revenus (CRO), vous servirez de lien entre nos objectifs commerciaux et nos capacités techniques. Vous collaborerez avec une équipe Produit axée sur l'expérience développeur et une équipe d'Ingénierie qui privilégie une infrastructure robuste, garantissant ainsi à nos plus grands marchands (jeux et fintech) une expérience d'intégration fluide et de calibre mondial dès la première rencontre.

Vous serez le premier Ingénieur de Solutions dédié chez Paramount Commerce. Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle où vous héritez d'un manuel d'instructions; vous allez bâtir la fonction, définir notre mode d'engagement technique avec les marchands et devenir la personne indispensable sans laquelle l'équipe des ventes ne peut conclure de transactions stratégiques.

Le défi est de taille : nos contrats impliquent des marchands s'intégrant à diverses méthodes de paiement avec des flux de règlement distincts, des contraintes de conformité et des cas particuliers qui surgissent tardivement si personne ne les détecte en amont. Lorsqu'une plateforme de jeux doit comprendre comment le "Demander un paiement" d'Interac fonctionne avec sa configuration d'acquisition de cartes actuelle, ou qu'une bourse de crypto doit mapper nos flux A2A à son architecture de trésorerie, c'est vous qui rendez le tout concret.

Actuellement, ce travail est réparti entre les Produits, l'Ingénierie, l'Intégration et le Développement des affaires, ce qui ralentit les ventes et crée des surprises après la signature. Votre mission est de vous approprier cet espace, d'éliminer l'ambiguïté et de rendre notre processus de vente technique aussi solide que notre infrastructure.

Vos Responsabilités

Être l'autorité technique à la table

Participez aux conversations de vente stratégiques et avancées où la crédibilité technique fait la différence entre gagner ou perdre un contrat.

  • Expliquer le fonctionnement de nos solutions de paiement, leurs limites et les exigences réelles d'intégration.
  • Structurer des solutions à travers diverses méthodes (A2A, Interac, TEF), flux de règlement et contraintes de conformité.
  • Identifier les risques tôt pour éviter que les contrats ne gagnent une complexité fatale après la signature.

Traduire entre deux mondes

Travaillez directement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les ingénieurs de paiement et les architectes techniques des marchands pour comprendre leurs besoins. Devenez la source de vérité fiable en documentant :

  • Les flux d'intégration et l'architecture technique.
  • Les cas particuliers et les dépendances de conformité.
  • Les lacunes des produits et les améliorations requises.

Gérer l'avant-vente technique de bout en bout

Dirigez la découverte technique et la conception de solutions, de la première conversation jusqu'au transfert à l'équipe de livraison. À terme, vous créerez les actifs reproductibles pour passer à l'échelle :

  • Modèles de solutions par secteur (jeux, transferts de fonds, crypto, places de marché).
  • Guides d'intégration et cadres de qualification technique.
  • FAQ et guides de gestion des objections pour réduire la dépendance envers les équipes Produit et Ingénierie.

Optimiser l'après-signature

Collaborez avec les équipes de mise en œuvre pour assurer des transferts propres qui réduisent le délai de lancement.

  • Assurer des transitions fluides entre les Ventes et la Livraison avec un contexte technique complet.
  • Identifier les points de friction récurrents et les intégrer à la feuille de route produit.

Bâtir la fonction

Définissez le modèle d'engagement entre l'ingénierie de solutions, les ventes, la gestion de comptes et le produit. Vous posez les fondations d'un département appelé à croître.

Profil Recherché

Expertise approfondie en paiements

  • 7 à 10 ans et plus en ingénierie de solutions ou avant-vente technique dans le secteur des paiements.
  • Compréhension opérationnelle de l'écosystème canadien et américain : Interac (Virement, Demande de paiement, RTR), flux A2A et TEF, acquisition de cartes, et différences entre PSP, processeurs et passerelles.
  • Expérience directe dans les intégrations pour les jeux, la crypto ou la fintech.

Aisance technique et commerciale

  • Capacité de discuter de modèles d'authentification API avec des ingénieurs, puis d'enchaîner sur une négociation commerciale concernant les délais de règlement.
  • Solide connaissance pratique des API, webhooks, réconciliation et flux de règlement.

Crédibilité auprès des marchands

  • Habileté à gérer des questions techniques pointues et à guider des parties prenantes qui ne comprennent pas toujours pleinement leurs propres systèmes vers la clarté.

Mentalité de bâtisseur

  • Vous avez déjà été le premier employé SE ou avez évolué dans un environnement où vous deviez créer les processus. Vous n'attendez pas de permission pour corriger une inefficacité.

Pourquoi Paramount Commerce ?

  • Entreprise canadienne avec plus de 22 ans d'histoire 🇨🇦

  • Vacances généreuses + vendredis d'été

  • Jour de congé pour votre anniversaire et journées de bénévolat

Divulgation de la rémunération : La fourchette de salaire de base pour ce poste est de 150 000 $à 190 000$ CAD, plus prime de performance.

Engagement envers la DEI : Chez Paramount Commerce, nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. title: 1st Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

As a Residential Support Specialist, you will provide a supportive and safe environment in community residential settings within MHA’s ICL (Integrated Community Living) department. This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

title: Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.
  • Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.
  • Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.
  • Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.
  • Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.
  • Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.
  • Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.
  • 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.
  • Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.
  • Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.
  • Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.
  • Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).
  • Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.
  • Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

title: Country Lead - Indonesia
description:
About Mitti Labs

Mitti Labs is building the infrastructure layer to scale climate-smart rice farming, starting with methane-reduction, water replenishment and stubble burning reduction. We combine AI-based dMRV, satellite data, and deep on-ground operations to verify practices and aggregate farmers at scale across India and Southeast Asia. Our customers — including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri-businesses — trust Mitti to deliver measurable impact across climate, water, and food systems. We are a team of 90+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators across India, US, and Europe.

Over the past 18 months, Mitti has scaled to 70,000+ smallholder rice farmers and become a leader in high quality credits. Click here to watch a video on Mitti's work on the ground.

The Role

Indonesia is the world’s third-largest rice producer, with over 8 million smallholder farming households cultivating rice. Rice cultivation is also one of Indonesia’s largest sources of agricultural methane and water use, making it both a massive climate challenge and an extraordinary opportunity for high-quality carbon removal.

The Country Lead – Indonesia is a founding role. You will design, launch, and scale Mitti Labs’ initial projects in Indonesia. You will lead the team from our first pilot cohort of farmers to a multi-province, high-impact programs. You will wear strategy and operations hat and build a capable team from scratch.

1. Market Entry

  • Design and own Indonesia’s operations roadmap: regional feasibility, budget planning, and building partnerships.
  • Develop localized farmer onboarding strategies that reflect regional value chains, community power structures, last-mile realities, and seasonal farming calendars.
  • Navigate Indonesia’s carbon regulatory landscape: KLHK carbon registry, SRN-PPI compliance, and emerging domestic carbon market mechanisms.

2. On-Ground Operations

  • Design and manage district specific operational playbooks -SOPs, training manuals, QA/QC frameworks
  • Build genuine trust with farming communities at the grassroots level — understanding local power dynamics, working with village heads, FPO leaders, and community mobilizes.

3. Team Building & Leadership

  • Hire and develop a high-performing in-country team.
  • Build a culture that reflects Mitti’s ethos
  • Manage external implementation partners and field agent networks

Requirements

  • +8 years in operations, agriculture, or rural development with clear evidence of building programs from scratch and scaling.
  • Direct experience managing agricultural field operations in Indonesia - preferably rice.
  • Track record with government department and related NGO relationships is a bonus.
  • Experience in agri-input distribution or farmer community leadership is strongly preferred.
  • Bahasa Indonesia fluency is required. English proficiency is essential for internal collaboration.
  • Willingness to travel 40–60% across provinces and in remote farming areas.

Benefits

  • Build projects that matter: a first-of-its-kind climate and food-security program in one of the world’s most important agricultural nations.
  • Founding role: genuine ownership, genuine impact. You will be Mitti Labs in Indonesia.
  • Work with a world-class team combining the best of science, product, business, and operations — with a culture of openness, direct collaboration, and unbiased decision-making.
  • Backed by leading climate investors with the resources to build for the long term.
  • Direct relationship with founders and leadership in a fast-scaling, mission-driven organization.

The Residential Support Specialist plays a crucial role in creating a supportive and secure living environment for individuals with acquired brain injuries. title: Receiving and Store Room Clerk
description:
About us

The Mississaugua Golf and Country Club (MGCC) is one of Canada’s top private all-season golf clubs, with a diverse membership of 1,500 members and an outstanding Tier One golf course famous for its excellence. The Club has played host to numerous premier events, including six Canadian Opens. We are also proud host of the 2025 CPKC Women’s Open Tournament.

Founded in 1906, MGCC is a year-round private club that offers golf, curling and tennis, fitness, dining, and social amenities. Our Tudor Clubhouse is a spectacular venue for casual and fine dining, banquets, weddings and various social events and functions.

Mississaugua Golf & Country Club is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work® in Canada. This recognition is based directly on employee feedback and reflects our commitment to creating a workplace built on trust, respect, collaboration, and a shared sense of pride in the work we do together

At MGCC we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents. This means that we are committed to cultivating and preserving a work culture where we celebrate who we are and where everyone feels seen and heard.

Position Summary

The Mississaugua Golf and Country Club is seeking a part-time Receiving and Store Room Clerk to join our dynamic and fun team. The Receiving and Store Room Clerk will be responsible for managing and coordinating the purchasing and receiving of MG&CC beverage items, as well as some materials, as needed. 1725 Mississauga Rd. (Mississauga Rd. & QEW) (Toronto, Canada Area)

title: Labourers (Civil Construction)
description:
Wilco Contractors Northwest Inc. is a growing leader in civil construction, building the roads, parks, communities, and infrastructure that Edmonton and surrounding areas rely on. From earthworks and grading to underground utilities, landscaping, and site development, our crews take on a wide variety of projects—and we’re looking for people who want to be part of the team.

We are looking for motivated Civil Construction and General Construction Labourers who are ready to work hard, learn new skills or provide existing experience, and build a career in the construction industry. You don’t need years of experience—we’re looking for people with a great attitude, strong work ethic, reliability, and a willingness to learn.

This is an opportunity to get hands-on experience, work alongside experienced operators and tradespeople, and develop skills that can open the door to future opportunities with Wilco.

This is a seasonal position working on projects throughout Edmonton and surrounding municipalities. Candidates must have reliable transportation to travel to various job sites.

Wilco Contractors Northwest will no longer accept applications in person, via fax, or email. Please apply online.

If you’re someone who shows up, works hard, takes safety seriously, and wants to learn, we want to hear from you.

Successful candidates will perform a variety of physical labour tasks on civil construction and open-space projects and will operate a variety of hand and power tools. Work is physically demanding and requires the ability to work outdoors in changing conditions.

The position typically involves 10–12 hour days, Monday through Saturday, and includes some or all of the following:

Responsibilities

  • Work in parks- trails- ravines- river valley- urban landscapes!
  • Cart and spread topsoil and other materials.
  • Lay sod or seed. Plant shrubs and trees.
  • Perform other duties to assist with the construction of a landscape and related structures.
  • Utilize concrete to form foundations/pads/. Build and position forms for pouring concrete, and dismantle forms after use.
  • Build retaining walls, paving stone installation, underground utility installation and other types of civil work.
  • Operation of small packers, shoveling, heaving lifting, etc.
  • Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, compact and level earth to grade specifications, using appropriate tools.
  • Load and unload construction materials from trucks and move them to the worksite.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Kensington delivers the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that’s tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure that they enjoy the authentic best of their destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime!

We achieve this because of our extraordinary people, passionate experts with deep knowledge of their destinations. They are what enables us to deliver remarkable experiences in over 120 countries worldwide, and across each of our businesses – Private Touring, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Expeditions, Ultraluxe Land, Private Jets, and Air.

To learn more about Kensington, visit .

We are hiring at two levels. We welcome applications from both Frontend Developers and Senior Frontend Developers. The level offered will be based on the depth of the candidate’s experience, technical expertise, scope of ownership, and ability to lead work independently.

This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON.

OUR ORGANIZATION

Kensington and TripArc, as part of the Range Group, deliver the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that is tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure they experience the authentic best of each destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime.

We achieve this through extraordinary people with deep destination expertise across more than 120 countries and across our Tours, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Jets, and Air brands.

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com.

To learn more about TripArc, visit triparc.com.

THE ROLE

Kensington and TripArc are expanding their development team to support projects and initiatives across kensingtontours.com, campaign landing pages, microsites, booking and enquiry flows, and related digital properties. You will work in a modern frontend stack that includes Next.js, React, Contentful, and Amplitude while helping complete a migration from a legacy Angular application and supporting a full brand redesign.

At either level, you will create performant, accessible, responsive experiences for high-traffic, revenue-generating pages and use measurement to understand whether what you ship is working. The scope of ownership will be aligned to your experience:

  • Frontend Developer: You will build and maintain features within established patterns, implement experiments and analytics tracking, contribute to Contentful integrations and the design system, and grow your capability in conversion, performance, and technical discoverability through coaching and code review.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: You will own frontend conversion, experimentation, performance, and technical discoverability as a practice. You will set standards, make architectural decisions, partner directly with senior marketing and digital stakeholders, mentor developers, and translate commercial goals into measurable, maintainable technical solutions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Build high-quality frontend experiences

  • Design, build, and maintain features in our modern frontend application using Next.js and React, including Contentful integrations.
  • Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into performant, accessible, responsive, mobile-first experiences and raise questions where requirements are unclear.
  • Build reusable components against our design system and contribute to the component library as we move into a full rebrand.
  • Configure or architect content models and CMS structures so marketing partners can build and update pages without developer support.
  • Maintain our legacy Angular application during migration and help retire it cleanly.
  • Write maintainable code, participate in code review, estimate work honestly, identify risks early, and document solutions for technical and non-technical partners.

Improve conversion and measurement

  • Implement and instrument experiment variants on high-value pages, including event tracking, funnel visibility, and analytics needed to assess results.
  • Partner with marketing and digital stakeholders to translate commercial hypotheses into testable changes with clear success criteria.
  • Use experiment results and analytics to report whether changes worked and identify where users drop out of key journeys.
  • For Senior candidates: own the experimentation practice, design tests, establish staged rollout and rollback guardrails, and ensure results are measured honestly.

Protect performance and discoverability

  • Build experiences that meet expectations for Core Web Vitals, accessibility, application security, crawlability, and search discoverability.
  • Use appropriate rendering strategies and frontend patterns based on content volatility, speed, performance, and crawlability.
  • Support technical SEO through semantic structure, structured data, internal linking, redirects, URL changes, and migration safety.
  • For Senior candidates: set and defend performance budgets, own production performance improvements, and build the technical foundations for SEO, AEO, and GEO.

Collaborate and lead at the appropriate level

  • Communicate clearly with engineering, design, content, SEO, marketing, and digital partners.
  • Bring forward options, trade-offs, risks, and evidence rather than presenting only one answer.
  • For Intermediate candidates: learn actively from code review and technical direction, ask questions early, and take increasing ownership of defined areas.
  • For Senior candidates: define frontend standards and architectural patterns, review code, mentor developers, and act as a senior technical voice with business stakeholders.

MUST-HAVE

For both levels

  • Professional experience building and supporting web applications in production environments with real user traffic.
  • Strong component-based development experience with React and hands-on experience with Next.js.
  • Solid frontend fundamentals, including component architecture, state management, routing, rendering lifecycle, and frontend performance.
  • Strong modern CSS skills and experience building responsive, mobile-first user interfaces.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub and working within a modern CI/CD pipeline.
  • Ability to translate designs into accessible, responsive, production-ready experiences and familiarity with Figma-based design handoffs.
  • Working knowledge of the web-platform fundamentals that affect commercial outcomes, including accessibility, SEO, Core Web Vitals, analytics, and application security.

For Frontend Developer

  • 3-5 years of professional web development experience building and supporting production web applications.
  • Solid React development experience with hands-on experience using Next.js.

For Senior Frontend Developer

  • 6+ years of professional frontend development experience, including significant work on high-traffic, revenue-generating websites or applications.
  • Deep expertise in React and Next.js, including component architecture, state management, routing, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Production experience with rendering strategies such as SSR, SSG, and ISR, and the ability to select the appropriate approach based on business and technical requirements.
  • Experience integrating headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful, including designing scalable content models and schemas.

NICE TO HAVE

  • A/B or multivariate testing tools such as Amplitude, Optimizely, VWO, or LaunchDarkly.
  • Analytics and tag implementation using Amplitude, GA4, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent tools.
  • Performance tooling such as Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, WebPageTest, and Chrome DevTools.
  • Technical SEO tooling such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or Botify.
  • Image and media optimization at scale, including modern formats, responsive delivery, CDN behaviour, and Cloudinary.
  • Personalization or content-variant delivery and an understanding of caching and indexing considerations.
  • Internationalization and Hreflang for multi-region sites.
  • Angular 9+, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury, or high-content-volume ecommerce.

OUR TECH STACK

  • React, GraphQL, and Next.js for the modern application.
  • Angular, .NET Core, and C# for the legacy application.
  • Contentful and Cloudinary.
  • Amplitude for analytics and experimentation.
  • Azure DevOps.

COMPENSATION

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay-for-performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The expected compensation range for this position is:

  • Frontend Developer: $90,000 to $110,000 CAD.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: $110,000 to $125,000 CAD.

The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography, and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. #LI-Hybrid

We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.

The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by the hiring team.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: 3rd Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

As a Residential Support Specialist, you will provide a supportive and safe environment in community residential settings within MHA’s ICL (Integrated Community Living) department. This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

Pay Range: $19 - $21 an hour

Open Shift: Thursday through Saturday 11pm-9am (30hrs)

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide respectful, person-centered support to participants in daily living activities, personal care, and skill development.
  • Promote community integration by facilitating access to transportation, social activities, and external resources.
  • Support participants' health needs, including medication administration (per MAP standards), appointment scheduling, and monitoring overall wellbeing.
  • Assist with financial skills and money management, maintaining accurate documentation of all expenditures.
  • Respond to emergencies and crisis situations appropriately, following agency protocols and communicating with supervisors.
  • Advocate for participants and help them build self-advocacy skills; serve as a liaison with families, providers, and community supports.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of Individual Service Plans (ISPs), documenting progress and participation.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including daily logs, incident reports, and health records.
  • Promote a safe environment by following all safety procedures, assisting with emergency drills, and identifying potential hazards.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members, attend training, maintain certifications (MAP, CPR, First Aid), and actively participate in meetings and supervision.

About Integration & Community Living (ICL)

The Integration & Community Living (ICL) program supports individuals with developmental disabilities and brain injuries in living independently and meaningfully in the community. In partnership with the Department of Developmental Services (DDS), ICL provides person-centered residential and outreach services across Western Massachusetts. With over 60 years of experience, MHA helps individuals transition from institutional settings into homes where they can grow, make choices, and fully participate in community life. Services range from supported and shared living to emergency respite and privately funded care, all designed to promote independence, dignity, and connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The Mental Health Association is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and computer skills.
  • Adaptability to participants' changing needs.
  • Provide personal care, including assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.
  • Ability to pass and maintain certifications in medication administration (MAP), CPR, and First Aid.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • High school diploma or GED required; college degree in human services or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of six months of relevant experience; experience with individuals with brain injuries, mental health challenges, or developmental disabilities is preferred.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (403B, IRA)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • $19-21 an hour

title: Part-Time Program Assistant at Day Center
description:

They serve as a member of the program services team; they support and work with them to serve the community by providing trauma-informed assistance. This is a unionized position, represented by Local 8 of the Office and Professional Employees International Union (OPEIU).

ABOUT THE PROGRAM: Compass Day Services includes the Client Services Office (CSO), the Hygiene Center, and the Day Services Center. The Day Center offers comfort and stability to those in need. People can seek refuge, meals, and basic services, as well as connect with housing navigation support, case management, mental health counseling and nursing services. The Hygiene Center offers individuals experiencing homelessness a place to use the restroom, take a hot shower, and do a load of laundry. The CSO provides free mail services for individuals who are housing insecure.

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION: Compass Housing Alliance develops and provides essential services, shelter, and affordable housing so that everyone in our community has a safe place to call home. We envision a world in which every person lives in a safe and caring community. Compass offers an open, supportive, and challenging work environment committed to promoting the dignity and well-being of each person that we serve. We recognize the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to the organization. We expect all employees to make efforts in their work and in their conduct to be welcoming to all. As of 2026, Compass Housing Alliance is a division of Lutheran Community Services Northwest (LCSNW). After years of affiliation and partnership, Compass and LCSNW joined together as one organization aligned in our shared values: compassion, love, health, justice, and hope. By combining LCSNW’s network of health and human services and Compass’s expertise in affordable housing and emergency services, we can provide holistic support to the communities we serve.

LOCATION: Pioneer Square Neighborhood (Seattle, WA)

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. The employee in this position must be able to read, write, and understand English.


Direct Services

  • Mediate conflicts and provide de-escalation and crisis intervention; model appropriate problem solving and refer to appropriate services as needed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

title: Head of Brand & Community - Modern AI Platform
description:
About Modern

Modern is an AI-native data and intelligence platform for commerce brands, and an ai Residency that runs on it every day.

That second part matters more than it sounds. Our ai Residency team operates a portfolio of DTC brands using this exact platform: attribution, cohort analysis, media mix, creator performance, lifecycle. Every feature has already survived contact with real P&Ls and real clients before it reaches anyone else.

It also means you'll have something most B2B social people would trade a limb for: a constant supply of real data, real results, and real operator stories to build content from.

The Role

Modern should be the company operators can't stop talking about. The platform they feel behind for not using yet.

We're not there. The product earns that reputation; the market doesn't know it yet. Your job is to close that gap.

You own how Modern shows up publicly and how demand gets created. Social is the center of gravity. The day-to-day craft of this job is content and community across platforms, and everything else extends from it.

The hard part of this role is audience. You're talking to two groups at once. AI-native builders and technical operators who will judge us instantly on whether we actually know what we're talking about, and brand owners doing $5M–$50M who care about one thing: does this make me money. Content that impresses the first group often alienates the second. You need to speak to both without sounding like you're hedging, and know which platform is for which.

What You'll Own

Content strategy and execution across every platform. LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Reddit, and wherever the conversation moves next. Each one gets a distinct approach, not the same post reformatted five ways. You're writing, filming, editing, and shipping. This is a hands-on role.

Community, not just audience. Showing up in the places operators already are: Reddit threads, Slack and Discord communities, comment sections, DMs, and building relationships rather than broadcasting. Eventually, building a space of our own.

Founder and executive brand. Leadership's personal accounts are often the highest-converting channel in B2B. You'll ghostwrite, coach, and build a consistent presence for our executives on LinkedIn and X.

AI creator and influencer partnerships. Sourcing, vetting, and managing relationships with AI-native creators and commerce operators who can credibly speak about what we've built. You'll run this end-to-end and partner closely with the Head of Sales, since these relationships turn into pipeline.

Demand generation beyond social. Newsletter, podcast or video series, webinars, events and conference presence. You'll decide which of these are worth doing and prove it before scaling.

Turning data into content. This is our unfair advantage. We sit on aggregate commerce performance data and a portfolio of brands with real outcomes. Benchmark reports, teardowns, trend analysis, "here's what actually happened when" posts. You'll work with the data team to turn that into content nobody else can publish.

Measurement. You'll define what good looks like beyond follower count and report on it honestly. Reach and engagement, yes, but also site traffic, signups, pipeline influenced, and community growth.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You've learned the product well enough to have opinions about it, audited our current presence and our competitors', and delivered a channel-by-channel strategy with a clear argument for where to focus first.

First 90 days: A consistent publishing cadence running across priority platforms. Executive accounts active. A first data-driven content asset shipped. Early creator conversations underway.

First 6 months: Measurable growth in audience and, more importantly, inbound. A working creator program with active partners. Content is generating conversations the sales team can act on.

First 12 months: Modern has a recognizable voice in the commerce-AI conversation. Social is a documented source of pipeline. You know which channels deserve more investment and can defend it with numbers.

Who You Are

5+ years in social, with B2B SaaS or AI experience. This is firm. If your background is consumer brands, personal influencer accounts, or DTC product marketing only, this isn't the right role. Selling software to operators is a different craft and the learning curve would be too steep. B2B commerce-tech or martech experience is ideal.

You're a strong writer with a distinct voice. B2B social lives or dies on whether it sounds like a person. You can write something sharp and specific rather than something safe.

You're deep in the AI landscape. You follow what's shipping, you understand the difference between a real capability and a demo, and you can explain any of it to someone who doesn't care about the technology, only the outcome. You use AI tools in your own workflow and you're fast because of it.

You understand commerce operators. You know what a brand owner's day looks like, what they're anxious about, and what makes them roll their eyes. You can spot marketing that's talking down to them.

You can produce, not just plan. Scripting, filming, editing, designing a passable graphic. You'll have support, but you should be able to take an idea to published without a queue.

You know how communities work because you've been in them. You've built or grown one, or you're a real participant in several. This isn't something you can fake for long.

You think in funnels, not vanity metrics. You can connect a piece of content to a business outcome, and you're honest when you can't.

Bonus Points

  • You've built a founder's personal brand from near-zero
  • You've run an influencer or creator program in B2B, where the playbook is much less obvious than in consumer
  • You've launched a newsletter or podcast that people actually read or listen to
  • Experience with e-commerce, DTC, or marketing analytics
  • You have your own audience in the AI or commerce space
  • You've built automation or agentic workflows to scale your own content production

Why This Role

Content nobody else can make. Aggregate commerce data and a portfolio of brands with documented outcomes. Most B2B marketers are inventing thought leadership from nothing; you'll have receipts.

Full ownership. You're not one voice on a marketing team. You define what Modern sounds like and you're the first marketing hire on the platform side.

A category being written right now. AI in commerce is unsettled. Whoever explains it clearly gets to shape how people think about it. That's a rare window.

Honest about the stage: you'll be a team of one for a while, and the scope is genuinely wide. You'll have to choose what not to do. If you need a defined lane and a content calendar handed to you, this will be frustrating.

Benefits

Competitive salary

Competitive health benefits

Unlimited PTO

Health and wellness credit

Fully remote

A front-row seat at an AI-native company building the future of how brands and creators work together

title: Recruiting Analytics Data Engineer
location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Recruiting Analytics Data Engineer to join our People Data Solutions team, focusing on building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our recruiting analytics capabilities. You'll be the technical foundation for our recruiting analytics team, designing scalable data architectures and implementing robust data models that enable evidence-based decision-making across Anthropic.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and recruiting analytics - you'll build the technical foundation for insights about recruiting funnels, interviews, and workforce planning while working with a team that's actively experimenting with AI to transform how we understand and support our workforce.

Key responsibilities

Data Infrastructure & Modeling

  • Refactor and optimize our existing BigQuery tables to create a scalable data foundation that supports and enables AI-driven data insights across the company

  • Design scalable data architectures and build dimensional models that transform raw HR data into trusted, reusable datasets for self-serve analytics while maintaining performance

  • Implement data governance including documentation, lineage tracking, quality monitoring, and proactive alerting systems

  • Ensure appropriate data access controls including row and column-level security for sensitive candidate data

Pipeline Development & Integration

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using dbt and Google BigQuery to integrate data from our HRIS (Workday), ATS (Greenhouse), and internal tools

  • Create reliable data flows that handle both real-time needs and batch processing requirements

  • Design fault-tolerant data pipelines with proper error handling and monitoring to ensure data freshness

  • Automate data quality checks and validation across all pipelines

Analytics Engineering & Modeling

  • Develop semantic layers and comprehensive documentation that make complex recruiting data accessible to non-technical users

  • Build data products that standardize key metrics like offer accept rate, time to fill, and headcount movement

  • Partner with data scientists, software engineers, recruiting teams, and various other stakeholders to build scalable data models that serve needs across the company

Minimum qualifications

  • Are an expert in BigQuery including optimization and partitioning

  • Have built dimensional models and understand slowly changing dimensions

  • Are proficient in SQL, Python, and modern tools like dbt and Fivetran

  • Have implemented data security and privacy controls in cloud warehouses

  • Can translate HR concepts into scalable data models

  • Communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

  • Have 5+ years in data engineering

  • Familiarity with ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever) and their data structures

  • Experience with building semantic layers for data agents

  • Experience building data pipelines for survey data and text analytics

  • Knowledge of graph databases or network analysis libraries

  • Background in privacy-enhancing technologies or sensitive data handling

  • Previous experience in high-growth technology companies or AI/ML organizations

  • Familiarity with workforce planning and predictive analytics use cases

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$285,000—$380,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Χειριστές Ανυψωτικών Οχημάτων
description:
Η Pharmathen, η οποία ιδρύθηκε το 1969, έχει εξελιχθεί σε μία από τις μεγαλύτερες, καθετοποιημένες εταιρείες ανάπτυξης τεχνολογιών σύνθετων φαρμακευτικών σκευασμάτων και συγκαταλέγεται μεταξύ των 50 κορυφαίων ερευνητικών φαρμακευτικών εταιρειών στην Ευρώπη.

Η εταιρεία έχει στη διάθεσή της ένα από τα πιο εκτεταμένα και προηγμένα χαρτοφυλάκια στον κλάδο, με έμφαση στα Ενέσιμα Προϊόντα Βραδείας Αποδέσμευσης (LAI), τα Σκευάσματα Ελεγχόμενης Αποδέσμευσης και τα Οφθαλμικά σκευάσματα.

Το εξαιρετικά διαφοροποιημένο χαρτοφυλάκιο της Pharmathen αποτελείται από περισσότερα από 90 εμπορικά προϊόντα που παράγονται στις εγκαταστάσεις παραγωγής της στην Ελλάδα, οι οποίες είναι εγκεκριμένες από τον Οργανισμό Τροφίμων και Φαρμάκων των ΗΠΑ (FDA) και την ΕΕ, εξυπηρετεί 250 πελάτες και είναι προσβάσιμο από ασθενείς σε περισσότερες από 90 χώρες παγκοσμίως.

Η Pharmathen είναι υπερήφανη που απασχολεί περισσότερους από 1.600 ανθρώπους, οι οποίοι ανήκουν σε περισσότερες από 28 διαφορετικές εθνικότητες, με το 54% του συνολικού εργατικού δυναμικού της και το 66% της ομάδας έρευνας και ανάπτυξης να είναι γυναίκες. Η μακροχρόνια επιτυχία της εταιρείας αποδίδεται στο πάθος για δημιουργία, το ήθος και την αφοσίωση των ανθρώπων της, οι οποίοι παραμένουν προσηλωμένοι στο όραμα της εταιρείας να κάνει τη διαφορά στις ζωές των ανθρώπων.

Στα πλαίσια της ανάπτυξης της, η Pharmathen Pharmaceuticals επιθυμεί να εντάξει στο ανθρώπινο δυναμικό της:

Χειριστές Ανυψωτικών Οχημάτων για την αποθήκη της στον Ασπρόπυργο.

Ο χειριστής ανυψωτικού οχήματος είναι υπεύθυνος για την ορθή παραλαβή, εκφόρτωση, σήμανση και μεταφορά όλων των προϊόντων εντός της αποθήκης, καθώς και για την τροφοδοσία των τμημάτων παραγωγής και συσκευασίας, εξασφαλίζοντας την ασφάλεια, την ακρίβεια και την ομαλή ροή των διαδικασιών.

Requirements

Πιο συγκεκριμένα:

Βασικές Αρμοδιότητες:

  • Χειρισμός ανυψωτικού οχήματος για τη φόρτωση, εκφόρτωση και μεταφορά φαρμακευτικών προϊόντων εντός της αποθήκης. Διαχείριση υλικών συσκευασίας και πρώτων υλών
  • Διαχείριση αποθεμάτων και σωστή τακτοποίηση προϊόντων σύμφωνα με τις διαδικασίες της αποθήκης.
  • Συμμόρφωση με τους κανόνες ασφαλείας και τις προδιαγραφές GMP.
  • Καταγραφή και τήρηση αρχείων αποθήκης και παραγωγικής διαδικασίας.
  • Διατήρηση καθαριότητας και οργάνωσης του χώρου εργασίας.

Απαραίτητα Προσόντα:

  • Απόφοιτοι Λυκείου
  • Ισχύουσα άδεια χειριστή ανυψωτικού
  • Εξοικείωση με ηλεκτρονικά συστήματα αποθήκης
  • Βασική γνώση της Αγγλικής γλώσσας

Επιθυμητά Προσόντα:

· 1 - 3 χρόνια εμπειρία σε φαρμακευτική εταιρία και πιο συγκεκριμένα στον τομέα της αποθήκης

Benefits

Η Εταιρεία προσφέρει:

  • Πολύ καλό εργασιακό περιβάλλον
  • Επιπρόσθετη ιδιωτική ιατροφαρμακευτική/νοσοκομειακή κάλυψη
  • Συνεχή εκπαίδευση σε μια εταιρεία δυναμικά αναπτυσσόμενη

H Pharmathen εφαρμόζει πολιτική ίσων ευκαιριών και σας ενθαρρύνει να υποβάλετε την αίτησή σας ανεξαρτήτως του φύλου, της ηλικίας, της θρησκείας, του σεξουαλικού προσανατολισμού, της εθνικότητας ή της φυλετικής καταγωγής σας.

title: Specialist, Vision Rehabilitation
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the lives of Canadians living with vision loss?

Vision Loss Rehabilitation Canada (VLRC) is a national health services organization dedicated to empowering people who are blind or partially sighted to live safely and independently. Our certified specialists provide client-centered rehabilitation, mobility training, and daily living skills programs that help clients build confidence and thrive. We work collaboratively with ophthalmologists, optometrists, and other health care professionals, offering essential care on a referral basis in homes, workplaces, and communities across the country. We value our employees as our greatest asset — and we’re committed to supporting their well-being, professional growth, and work-life balance. Learn more about VLRC at or call 1-844-887-8572.

Position Title: Specialist, Vision Rehabilitation

Location: London, ON

Term: Full-time, Contract till December 1, 2027 (Existing vacancy)

Reports To: Manager, Healthcare Operations

Salary: $28.83/hour

Posting Date: June 10, 2026

Closing Date: Until filled

I. Scope and Summary of Primary Responsibilities

In covering a broad range of duties and responsibilities include providing instruction and guidance in compensatory independent living skills, and assistive technology, enabling individuals living with vision loss to independently carry out daily activities. This position provides functional expertise for the comprehensive multi-faceted service and operations program.

II. Essential Functions

This position entails, but is not limited to the following general responsibilities:

· Assesses the independent living needs and abilities of individuals.

· With the individual, identifies and prioritizes goals, and develops an independent living plan.

· Teaches adaptive skills for independent living in areas of personal management, household management, communication, leisure activities, indoor orientation & mobility skills, and technology training.

· Assists individuals in the acquisition and use of assistive devices.

· Promotes self-advocacy skills for individuals living with vision loss to access community programs and resources (i.e. leisure programs, acquisition of adaptive equipment, etc.).

· Maintains all case data and documentation consistent with Vision Loss Rehabilitation Canada Systems and Procedures.

· Adherence to professional healthcare documentation, charting, and reporting.

· Provides consultation, public education, and in-service training.

· Performs administrative duties including, but not limited to service tracking, benchmarking, report writing, etc.

· Maintaining, facilitating, and conducting group sessions and presentations.

Relationships

· Liaises and builds relationships with community-based rehabilitation teams, agencies, schools, partners, health practitioners and stakeholders.

· Provides support and consultation to individuals and their families re adjustment to vision loss.

· Attends and participates in multi-disciplinary team meetings.

· Promotes an understanding and awareness of vision health related issues through consultation, public education, and in-service training.

· Assists with the training, placement and supervision of volunteers and students.

Problem Solving

· Provide timely delivery of services to ensure people living with vision loss acquire skills and assistive technology to remain/regain independence.

· Ability to creatively and quickly problem solve to respond to unique individual needs.

Decision Autonomy

· Utilizes standard procedures and processes to implement each individual’s unique independent living plan.

· Utilizes judgment when determining if the individual requires a referral to another VLRC service or external services.

Leadership

· Takes initiative to keep abreast of knowledge in the expertise of vision rehabilitation/independent living skills.

· Facilitate and enhance team efforts on a professional level and share specialized knowledge, sources, experience, concepts, and skills.

· Provides leadership to community groups and partners by educating, advocating and promoting awareness about vision loss.

· Provides leadership in training and coaching volunteers, students and staff.

Requirements

III. Qualifications

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

· Knowledge and experience working with individuals with vision loss.

· Knowledge and experience working with adaptive technology.

· Demonstrated individual centred approach and commitment.

· Mature and professional attitude.

· Knowledgeable about disabilities and all life stages (children to seniors).

· Well-developed interpersonal and communications skills.

· Decision-making and problem-solving ability.

· Self-directed, organized and detail oriented.

· Ability to travel within the province to deliver community-based services.

Experience and Education

· Graduate of the Instructor for Blind and Visually Impaired Program (Mohawk College); or Diploma in Specialized Studies, O&M and Vision Rehabilitation (University of Montreal) an asset.

· Undergraduate degree or equivalent.

· Eligible for ACVREP Certified Vision Rehabilitation Therapist (CVRT) certification.

· Good command of relevant computer applications.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Experience running and facilitating groups an asset.

Work Environment

· Service will be provided in office centers, individual homes and/or the community.

· Willingness to work flexible hours.

· Travel will be required.

Benefits

At VLRC, your work has real impact. Join a team that empowers Canadians with vision loss to live independently, and where your growth, well-being, and contributions matter. We offer:

  • Comprehensive benefits for health, vision, dental, corporate discounts employee and family assistance program
  • Flexible work arrangements, generous paid time off, and work-life balance initiatives
  • Career development through training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities
  • Inclusive work culture with supportive teams, employee recognition, joy in work wellness program, and mental health supports

Join us to grow your career and make a difference everyday.

Inclusion, Accessibility & Accommodation

VLRC is committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace. We welcome applications from members of groups that have been historically marginalized, including but not limited to Indigenous peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, including those who are blind, partially sighted, or deafblind, women and 2SLGBTQ+. We strongly encourage applications from applicants with sight loss to apply. Direct lived experience is valued as an asset. The successful candidate will be required to complete a standard Vulnerable Sector Check.

If you require an accommodation to apply or participate in the selection process, please contact janice.rego@vlrehab.ca. We’ll be happy to work with you to meet your needs.

Not sure if you qualify? Think about applying anyway!
We understand that not everyone brings 100% of the skills and experience for the role. If you bring passion, transferable skills, and a desire to make a difference, we encourage you to apply!VLRC does not use AI tools in its screening, assessment, or selection process.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Pulmonary Function Technologist
description:
WELL Health Diagnostic Centres is looking for a skilled and certified Full-Time Pulmonary Function Technologist who will be responsible for Performs pulmonary-function, lung-capacity, diffusion capacity, and blood-and-oxygen tests to gather data for use by physician in diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary disorders.

Job Description: Pulmonary Function Technologist

Reporting to: Clinic Leader / Regional Leader

About WELL Health Diagnostic Centres

WELL Health Diagnostic Centres is the largest operator of independent diagnostic health facilities in Ontario. More than 15,000 healthcare providers refer their patients to WELL Health Diagnostic Centres’ 60+ accredited locations for OHIP and AHCIP-covered cardiology, radiology, respirology, and sleep diagnostic services. We are committed to delivering shorter wait times, faster report turnaround, and the highest standard of patient care.

WELL Health Diagnostic Centres is a top employer of choice! We are dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining the best healthcare professionals in the industry. We are proud to be recognized year after year as an industry leader, earning distinctions such as Canada’s Best Managed Companies, Great Place to Work®, Canada’s Top Growing Companies from The Globe and Mail, and the Consumer Choice Award.

Why join WELL Health Diagnostic Centres? Here are 5 great reasons!

  • Compassionate & Connected Healthcare: Join a team of 1,000+ healthcare professionals across Canada dedicated to delivering excellent patient care while upholding the highest clinical standards.
  • Employee Wellness: We support your overall work-life balance and offer full access to our group medical benefits and external wellness platforms to support you in thriving both personally and professionally.
  • Competitive & Comprehensive Compensation: Enjoy competitive pay, extended health and dental benefits, paid time off, and exclusive perks through Perkopolis with 5,000+ discounts.
  • Grow with a Leading Organization: With 60+ clinics across Canada and upcoming rapid expansion, you’ll have the opportunity to advance your skills and build a meaningful career.
  • Collaborative & Supportive Culture: Work in a team-oriented environment with strong leadership, mentorship opportunities, continuing education support, training and development support, internal mobility, and clear pathways for career growth.

Responsibilities:

• Provide accurate and efficient administrative support to the management team of the department, while ensuring the day-to-day operations are managed, coordinated, and performed.

• Responsible for ensuring patient identification, safety and preparation are correct prior to a scan while maintaining patient confidentiality.

• Greet patient, explain forthcoming test, position patient and prepare him/her for examination.

• Performs pulmonary-function, lung-capacity, diffusion capacity, and blood-and-oxygen tests to gather data for use by physician in diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary disorders: Confers with patient in treatment room to explain test procedures.

• Explains specified methods of breathing to patient and conducts pulmonary-function tests, such as helium dilution and pulmonary mechanics, arterial blood gas analyses, and lung-capacity tests, such as vital capacity and maximum breathing capacity tests, using spirometer or other equipment.

• Measures expired air, using various analyzers.

• Observes and records readings on metering devices of analysis equipment and conveys findings of tests and analyses to physician for interpretation.

• Observe patient during the diagnostic procedure, making note of any symptoms or changes in vital signs and summon medical aid when necessary.

• Ensure all quality control assessments are performed as required. Takes all reasonable precautions and work in compliance with related policies, health and safety legislation and best practices.

• Follow procedures for proper equipment maintenance are completed in accordance with department standards.

• Ensure equipment and instruments are performing in an efficient and effective manner.

• Prepare and organize reports as required.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Experience & Requirements:

• 0-2 years of related experience.

• Current CPR certificate.

• Vmax system experience is an asset.

• An associate degree in respiratory therapy from an accredited program

• PFT testing experience in a body box setting would be an asset.

• Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrated commitment to continuing education and training.

• Demonstrate effective decision-making skills and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

WELL Health Diagnostic Centres does not use artificial intelligence-assisted tools as part of the recruitment process.

This role is for an existing vacancy. The expected hiring range for this role is from $42 - $45 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience level, and internal equity. Candidates with significantly more experience may be considered at a higher level with adjusted compensation for certain roles.

Follow us on LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/welldiagnostics.ca

WELL Health Diagnostic Centres welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: 2nd Shift Direct Care
description:

The Residential Support Specialist plays a crucial role in creating a supportive and secure living environment for individuals with acquired brain injuries. This position promotes personal growth, independence, and community engagement, embodying MHA’s Core Values of Respect, Integrity, and Compassion, while adhering to all relevant policies and guidelines.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff. Whether you're a trader, technologist, marketer, or operator - your work here shapes how thousands of users find and trust prop firms.

About the department

Data & Analytics is the function that turns raw business data into decisions. We own the data platform, product analytics, marketing attribution, and revenue operations analytics. Our current priority is building reliable data infrastructure that supports both day-to-day reporting and the next wave of AI-driven workflows at PFM.

About the role

Partner with Product and Engineering to shape product decisions through measurement of user behaviour, funnel performance, feature impact, experimentation, and conversion. Turn product data into clear recommendations on what to build, improve, stop, or test next.

Performance objectives

Objective 1 - Own product analytics and KPIs

Outcome: Clear, ongoing visibility into activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and feature adoption across the platform.

Typical tasks:

  • Own analytics across onboarding, rankings, quizzes, comparisons, firm pages, and checkout flows.
  • Define and monitor product KPIs.
  • Maintain product dashboards used by Product, Engineering, and Leadership.
  • Investigate anomalies and surface trends weekly.

Objective 2 - Build and maintain product funnels

Outcome: Drop-off points are identified faster; the biggest conversion opportunities are surfaced and prioritised.

Typical tasks:

  • Build product funnels end-to-end across the platform.
  • Identify friction points and quantify their impact.
  • Turn findings into prioritised recommendations for Product and Engineering.
  • Validate funnel improvements pre/post change.

Objective 3 - Lead experimentation

Outcome: Stronger experimentation culture; product decisions are validated rather than debated.

Typical tasks:

  • Design, analyse, and document A/B tests.
  • Help build PFM's experimentation framework.
  • Quantify feature impact pre- and post-launch.
  • Train product and engineering teams on test design.

Objective 4 - Communicate insights to drive decisions

Outcome: Product, Engineering, and Leadership are aligned on shared evidence; high product-team satisfaction with insight quality.

Typical tasks:

  • Produce product performance updates with strong visual storytelling.
  • Partner on roadmap prioritisation and launch measurement.
  • Define tracking requirements before features ship.
  • Present findings in product reviews and leadership forums.

Reporting cadence

  • Reports to: Head of Data & Analytics.
  • Direct reports: None.
  • Key cross-functional partners: Product, Engineering, Leadership, Marketing.
  • Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with Head of D&A; sprint-level product reviews; quarterly OKR review.

Compensation

$2,500–$4,500 / month gross

Location & work setup

  • Remote, with strong overlap with CET hours (4+ hours of overlap).
  • Working hours: roughly 9 AM – 6 PM CET, with reasonable flexibility.
  • Employment type: Full-time.

Requirements

What we look for

Must have

  • 2+ years of experience as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst on a product team.
  • Strong SQL and product analytics tooling (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).
  • Experimentation design and A/B testing experience.
  • Statistical thinking - comfortable with significance, power, segmentation.
  • Visual storytelling skills - can turn data into a clear narrative.
  • Excellent async written communication - we are remote-first.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in fintech, prop trading, or B2C SaaS.
  • Familiarity with attribution and funnel analytics at scale.
  • Experience defining and validating product hypotheses end-to-end.
  • Commercial mindset focused on outcomes, not just metrics.

Benefits

Hiring stages
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time.
Here’s what to expect:

1. Application screening:
We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role’s requirements. You’ll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.

2. Video intro + role fit questionnaire:
A short async step - no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront.

3. Discovery HR Interview
A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals.

4. Real-world task
A scoped exercise using real PFM product data. Expect to work with user behavior, funnel metrics, or feature performance - the kind of challenges you'd actually encounter in this role.

5. A deep-dive Professional interview
You will meet the Head of Data & Analytics at PFM to focus on your product analytics expertise - how you define and track metrics, interpret user data, and translate findings into decisions that shape the product roadmap.

6. Functional Interview
A broader professional conversation exploring how you collaborate with product
managers and designers, communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders, and approach ambiguous product questions with limited data.

7. Peer & values conversation
A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.

To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

Before applying take into account that:
▸ If you don’t meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires - we encourage you to apply.
▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
