title: [쿠팡] 글로벌 위기관리센터 운영담당자 (정규직)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 Global Security Operations Center(이하 GSOC)는 위기관리센터로서 내외부 위험에 대한 실시간 모니터링을 제공하고 사건/사고 발생시 위기관리 프로세스에 따라 신속한 대응을 주도하여 직원의 안전을 보장하고 비즈니스 운영의 연속성을 지원합니다. 회사에서 일어날 수 있는 다양한 사건, 사고에 대처하기 위해 24시간 365일 운영되며 사건/사고 발생시 해당 사건, 사고를 빠른 시간내에 전파하고 이를 해결할 수 있는 적절한 지원이 이뤄지도록 합니다.

업무 내용

  • Global Security 부서의 커뮤니케이션 허브 역할
  • 모니터링 시스템을 통해 인지된 다양한 리스크 및 사건사고 접수 및 적시 대응
  • 글로벌 이벤트 모니터링 및 영향 평가 후 GSOC의 파트너들에게 공유
  • 회사 운영, 임직원, 시설 및 고객에게 영향을 미칠 수 있는 외부 위협에 대한 인지, 위험성 평가 및 분류
  • 공급망 자산과 관련된 위험 모니터링 후 전달
  • GSOC Supervisor(Manager) 업무 지원

고용형태

  • 정규직
  • 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 진행

자격 요건

  • 비상관리, 안전관리, 환경, 경영, 경제, 커뮤니케이션, 정보기술, 정치 과학, 공학, 지리학, 경비학 등의 전공의 학사학위를 보유하신 분
  • 우수한 커뮤니케이션 기술을 통해 서면(필요시 구두)으로 경영진 수준과 의사소통 할 수 있는 능력이 있으신 분
  • 높은 스트레스 및 시간제약이 있는 상황에서 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분
  • 모호한 상황에서도 비판적으로 분석하고 사고하시는 분
  • 스스로 동기를 부여하고 대응력이 뛰어나며, 적극적이며 끝까지 작업을 주도하실 수 있는 분
  • 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 가능하신 분
  • 중급 이상의 영어 회화가 가능하신 분

우대 사항

  • 산업안전/EHS/물리 보안/군사/SOC(Security Operations Center)/관제/리스크관리/고객대응 등 관련 업계에 3년 이상 근무 경험을 가지신 분
  • 글로벌 이벤트와 글로벌 지리/문화에 대한 실무지식이 있으신 분
  • 컴퓨터 지식과 기술, 복잡한 플랫폼 작업을 경험하신 분
  • IT, 정보, 기업, 군사 또는 보안 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화 면접 - 대면 면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무 별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다 .
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류반환정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer - Modern AI Platform
description:
About Modern

Modern is an AI-native data and intelligence platform for commerce brands, and an ai Residency team that runs on it every day.

That second part matters more than it sounds. Our ai Residency team operates a portfolio of DTC brands using this exact platform: attribution, cohort analysis, media mix, creator performance, lifecycle. Every feature has already survived contact with real P&Ls and real clients before it reaches anyone else.

The Role

We've built something genuinely powerful. Now we want everyone to be able to use it.

The platform answers questions most tools in this category can't touch. Our engineering team built an engine with real depth. Sophisticated operators pick it up and don't want to work without it. That part is solved.

The opportunity is reach. Our market isn't only sophisticated growth teams. It's also the founder running an $8M skincare brand who knows their business cold and has never heard the word "incrementality." We want that person to get the same value from day one, and today the product assumes more context than they arrive with.

You're the first UX/UI Design hire. Your job is to make something powerful feel obvious, without making it any less powerful.

That second half is the hard part. The easy version of this role is to strip features out until it's simple. We don't want that. We want the depth fully preserved and the path to it made clear. Progressive disclosure, sane defaults, an interface that teaches you as you use it, and a first session that delivers a real answer before it asks you to understand anything.

What You'll Own

The product experience, end to end. Information architecture, core flows, onboarding, dashboards, data visualization, empty and error states, mobile. You'll audit what exists, decide what's broken, and make the case for the order in which we fix it.

Onboarding and time-to-value. The single highest-leverage surface in the product. A new user should reach a genuinely useful insight in their first session without reading documentation.

Data visualization. A large share of this product is charts, tables, and comparisons. Designing these well: what's the default view, what's hidden, what a number means without a glossary is a real craft, and it's central to this job.

Designing for AI interaction. Parts of the platform are conversational or agentic. The design patterns for this are still being invented industry-wide. You'll be inventing some of ours: how the system shows its reasoning, how it handles uncertainty, how a user knows what to trust and when to check.

A design system. The product has shipped fast and grown feature by feature, so patterns vary across surfaces. You'll build the components, tokens, and patterns that engineers ship against, so consistency stops being a per-feature negotiation.

The marketing site and brand. You also own how Modern looks to the outside world: the website, product marketing assets, the visual identity of the platform. The brand should look like it belongs to a company at the front of this category.

Research, at a scale that fits. You'll talk to users regularly. You have an unusual advantage here: our own ai Residency team uses the product for hours a day and will tell you exactly what's painful. Use them, but don't only use them. They're expert users, and your hardest design problem is the person who isn't.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You've used the platform the way a customer does, sat with agency operators while they work in it, and delivered a clear-eyed audit of where new users get stuck and what we should fix first. We want the unvarnished version.

First 90 days: A redesigned onboarding and first-run experience shipped. The beginnings of a design system in place. A prioritized roadmap of UX debt with a clear argument for sequencing.

First 6 months: The core dashboards redesigned and shipped. Measurable movement in activation and time-to-first-insight. Design is a real function here, not a request queue.

First 12 months: A non-technical brand owner can sign up, get to value on their own, and keep coming back. The design system is what engineering builds from by default. The marketing site reflects the product's actual quality.

Who You Are

5+ years designing SaaS products, with shipped work you can walk us through. Not just the final screens, but the problem, the constraints, what you tried first, and what you'd change now.

You've made complex software approachable before. Analytics, BI, fintech, dev tools, ops platforms, anything data-dense. This is the closest thing to a hard requirement on this list. Consumer-app polish alone won't transfer.

You're fluent in data visualization. You have opinions about chart types, and you know why most dashboards fail.

You work in the AI landscape and use AI in your own craft. You're paying attention to how AI products are being designed right now, you have views on what's working and what's cargo cult, and you use these tools in your own process. We're not looking for someone who outsources taste to a model. We're looking for someone whose taste is sharpened by moving fast.

You're comfortable being the whole design function. No team to delegate to, no researcher, no brand designer. You scope, design, ship, and measure. You know what "good enough for now" looks like and when it isn't.

You can build a case. You'll be advocating for design investment to engineers and leadership who have competing priorities. Strong visual work isn't enough. You need to explain why it matters in terms of activation, retention, and revenue.

You prototype. Static mockups only get an idea so far. Whether it's Figma prototypes, code, or AI-assisted, you show rather than describe.

Bonus Points

  • You write front-end code (React/Tailwind) and can ship your own work or spec it precisely
  • Experience with e-commerce, DTC, marketing analytics, or attribution
  • You've been the first design hire somewhere and remember what you learned
  • You've designed conversational or agentic interfaces
  • Brand and identity work in your portfolio alongside product

Why This Role

A rare setup: a product that already works. You're not designing something speculative. The engine runs and customers rely on it daily. Your work goes straight into making it reach a much wider audience, which is the biggest growth opportunity in the company right now.

Users on tap. An in-house team of expert operators uses this daily and will give you unfiltered feedback. Most designers wait weeks for research; you'll get it in an afternoon.

Full scope. Product, system, and brand. If you've been boxed into one of those, this is the role that isn't.

Honest about the stage: this is a first UX/UI design hire at an early-stage company. Some weeks will be about refining what already ships rather than designing what's next, and you'll be building the function as you go. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this isn't the right fit.

Benefits

Competitive salary

Competitive health benefits

Unlimited PTO

Health and wellness credit

Fully remote

A front-row seat at an AI-native company building the future of how brands and creators work together

title: 2nd & 1st Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

As a Residential Support Specialist, you will provide a supportive and safe environment in community residential settings within MHA’s ICL (Integrated Community Living) department. This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

Pay Range: $19 - $21 an hour

Open Shift: Wednesday through Saturday 3pm-11pm, Sunday 9am-3pm (38hrs)

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide respectful, person-centered support to participants in daily living activities, personal care, and skill development.
  • Promote community integration by facilitating access to transportation, social activities, and external resources.
  • Support participants' health needs, including medication administration (per MAP standards), appointment scheduling, and monitoring overall wellbeing.
  • Assist with financial skills and money management, maintaining accurate documentation of all expenditures.
  • Respond to emergencies and crisis situations appropriately, following agency protocols and communicating with supervisors.

About Integration & Community Living (ICL)

The Integration & Community Living (ICL) program supports individuals with developmental disabilities and brain injuries in living independently and meaningfully in the community. In partnership with the Department of Developmental Services (DDS), ICL provides person-centered residential and outreach services across Western Massachusetts.   • Minimum of six months of relevant experience; experience with individuals with brain injuries, mental health challenges, or developmental disabilities is preferred.

title: Vice President of Wholesale (Apparel)
description:
Some sales leaders love the chase. Others love the spreadsheet. A few love building teams. This job is for the rare person who loves all three.

You are a strategist who can see where the wholesale business should go next, and an entrepreneur who gets energized by the wide-open space between the idea and the result. You know how to build a plan, rally people around it, and create the systems that turn ambition into reliable growth. And when the moment calls for it, you are just as comfortable joining a customer meeting, solving an operational problem, or helping the team land an important account.

You have probably spent your career spotting opportunity before it became obvious. You understand that great wholesale leadership is part vision, part relationship, part operational discipline, and part rolling up your sleeves. You love the magic of bringing a new customer into the mix AND respect the machinery behind it: forecasting, assortment strategy, account planning, margins, process, talent, and follow-through.

At Life is Good, you will lead more than a sales channel. You will shape how our brand shows up in stores, build lasting partnerships, and help a wide variety of retailers bring the power of optimism to their customers and communities. You will inherit a beloved brand, a meaningful mission, and plenty of room to imagine what comes next.

We are looking for a builder, not a caretaker. A coach, not a commander. Someone who can zoom out to see the horizon, then zoom in far enough to notice what is keeping an order from shipping.

If that sounds like the kind of challenge you have been waiting for, we would love to hear the story of what you have built, who you have helped grow, and where you believe wholesale can go next.

Only those with apparel experience will be considered. This is a unique, fast-changing industry.

IMPORTANT DETAILS

  • This application requires a significant commitment to answering specific questions. You may want to compose your answers outside of this app and paste them once you're satisfied with your composition, spelling, grammar, and tone. We can't consider incomplete applications.
  • Our market-based compensation strategy determines base pay for our jobs. You can use publicly available tools to estimate what you might earn here. All permanent roles are eligible for an annual bonus based on company performance, to which you will make a significant contribution.
  • This role is based in Boston. You'll work on-site Wednesdays and Thursdays each week.
  • Everyone who applies will get a response from a human. Please do not apply if you are not now located in or willing to relocate to the Boston area. Remote work is not an option for this role
  • Although we love and use AI regularly, you're about to put a lot of heart and skill into this application and deserve a human response. You'll get one. If you don't answer the questions or meet the requirements below, you'll get a swift, kind rejection.

Pay Transparency:
We post our jobs on a collection of sites. Not all of them portray accurate information about our compensation ranges. For years, we've used a market-based approach to determine starting pay for all roles at Life is Good. We encourage you to explore reputable salary calculators like Salary.com or PayScale and, using accurate data for the apparel industry, this job (from the job description), our company size (under 300 people), location (Boston), and the required experience for this role (at least 10 years), you will see the pay range for this role.

Ready to learn more about the job? Read on...:

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS (Please do not apply unless you meet all of them)

  • Minimum of 3 years of P&L responsibility for an enterprise Wholesale business
  • Minimum of 10 years of industry experience, must include apparel
  • Documented success growing top- and bottom-line results with a large team
  • Knowledge gained through achieving at least a bachelor’s degree level of educational experience
  • You are willing and able to travel regularly to support the business
  • You live near, or are willing to relocate to Boston, Massachusetts

WHY THIS JOB EXISTS

You will lead, manage, and grow the Wholesale business in a brand-enhancing manner. You will have full P&L responsibility for the Wholesale business unit.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead a large team encompassing Sales, Sales Operations, Merchandising, Shops, and Customer Care for Life is Good and Keep it Simple.

  • Sales: Lead a team of 19 Independent and In-House sales representatives. Travel to meet key customers and attend relevant trade shows. Build sales plans and implement strategies that support strong customer retention and acquisition.
  • Sales Operations: Lead the team that manages wholesale-specific applications (e.g. the B2B websites), produces sales reports, analyzes account sell-in / sell-through, forecasts inventory needs, and collaborates with our production & fulfillment team to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
  • Merchandising: Lead the group that collaborates with the Product team to determine the seasonal, monthly, and at-once product offerings.
  • Shops: Oversee the management of the 51 independently owned and operated Life is Good Shops (along with 1 company-owned location). Ensure that their assortment, marketing, and in-store experience needs are met. Travel to visit stores. Recruit new owners and encourage existing owners to open new locations.
  • Customer Care: Lead the team entrusted with providing outstanding service to our wholesale customers.

Analyze the business by effectively using Life is Good technology and tools, including AI.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • You maintain a steady and optimistic demeanor
  • You are an enthusiastic brand ambassador and a cultural leader
  • You speak and write clearly, simply, and succinctly
  • You share our passion for social impact

WHEN YOU'LL KNOW YOU'RE SUCCESSFUL

  • You have formed successful cross-functional partnerships with other Leadership Team members and their teams
  • You and your team meet your annual goals
  • Others view you as a “company first” role model who consistently demonstrates our values to grow our brand, business, and culture

Benefits

We are located in the innovative and thriving Fort Point neighborhood. Our community is full of green space, outstanding food, and entertainment options. We offer top quality Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, Transit or Parking Reimbursement Accounts, Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) with a match, Paid Time off, 10 paid holidays, Good Vibes Time (we pay you to volunteer for the non-profit cause of your choice) and Family Time. And we have dogs. You’ll be involved in growing our social mission through the Playmaker Project.

Life is Good is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, mental or physical disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender orientation or expression, marital status or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic under applicable federal or state law.

What we offer you:

  • Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.

Compensation Transparency

In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location.

Job Grade: Director

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

title: Αποθηκάριος Ίλιον
description:
Η εταιρία Λακιώτης, στο πλαίσιο της δυναμικής της ανάπτυξης, αναζητά νέα μέλη για να ενισχύσουν την ομάδα της. Αν είσαι φιλόδοξος/η, με όρεξη για εξέλιξη και θέλεις να γίνεις μέρος μιας αναπτυσσόμενης και καινοτόμου εταιρίας, αυτή είναι η ευκαιρία σου!

Υπάλληλος Αποθήκης

Μια τυπική ημέρα στην εργασία περιλαμβάνει:

  • Παραλαβή, τοποθέτηση και έλεγχος δεμάτων
  • Συσκευασία παραγγελιών
  • Τοποθέτηση των συσκευασιών σε ράμπες φόρτωσης
  • Έλεγχος αποθεμάτων
  • Συμμετοχή στις ετήσιες απογραφές
  • Φόρτωση / Εκφόρτωση εμπορευμάτων
  • Υπεύθυνος για την καθαριότητα του χώρου ευθύνης του
  • Τήρηση των πολιτικών υγιεινής κι ασφάλειας και των προτύπων ποιότητας

Τι χρειάζεται να φέρεις μαζί σου:

  • Επιθυμητή προϋπηρεσία σε αντίστοιχη θέση εργασίας
  • Ευελιξία στο ωράριο εργασίας
  • Επιθυμητή γνώση χρήσης scanner

Εμείς θα σου παρέχουμε:

  • Σταθερή εργασία, πενθήμερης πλήρους πρωινής απασχόλησης (μια βάρδια)
  • Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών
  • Διαρκή κατάρτιση και δυνατότητα επαγγελματικής ανέλιξης
  • Bonus

Η Λακιώτης Α.Ε. είναι μία από τις κορυφαίες ελληνικές εταιρίες στον χώρο των ειδών υγιεινής και πλακιδίων, με ηγετική παρουσία στην αγορά από το 1978. Με έμφαση στην καινοτομία, την ποιότητα και την εξυπηρέτηση, παρέχουμε λύσεις υψηλών προδιαγραφών για ιδιώτες, επαγγελματίες και μεγάλα έργα. Επενδύουμε στη βιωσιμότητα, την τεχνολογία και τη συνεχή εξέλιξη, δημιουργώντας ένα εργασιακό περιβάλλον ανάπτυξης και δημιουργικότητας.

Γίνε μέλος μιας δυναμικής ομάδας που σχεδιάζει το μέλλον με σεβασμό στον άνθρωπο και το περιβάλλον!

title: Senior Motion Graphics Artist (Night Shift)
description:
Pixelogic Media is seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Motion Graphics Artist to lead and support a team of motion graphics professionals in delivering high-quality visual content. This role combines hands-on creative execution with team leadership, workflow management, mentoring, and project oversight. The ideal candidate is an expert in motion design, possesses strong problem-solving abilities, and can effectively bridge communication between creative teams and project management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support a team of Motion Graphics Artists to ensure high-quality project execution.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and constructive feedback to team members.
  • Foster a collaborative and creative team environment.
  • Assist in onboarding and training new team members.
  • Review project requirements and assets before production begins to identify potential issues and ensure readiness.
  • Set up project structures, templates, and workflows to maintain consistency and efficiency.
  • Manage workload distribution and monitor team progress against deadlines.
  • Ensure projects meet quality standards, client requirements, and delivery timelines.
  • Troubleshoot creative and technical challenges and provide effective solutions.
  • Serve as the primary point of communication between the Motion Graphics team and Project Managers.
  • Collaborate closely with the Creative Director to align creative output with business and client objectives.
  • Participate in project planning, status updates, and workflow improvement initiatives.
  • Communicate project risks, blockers, and resource needs proactively.
  • Create, edit, and enhance motion graphics content when required.
  • Review team deliverables and provide quality control before final submission.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, creative direction, and technical specifications.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Motion Graphics, Animation, or a related creative field.
  • Previous experience leading or mentoring creative teams.
  • Advanced proficiency in: Adobe After Effects , Adobe Premiere Pro ,Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, animation techniques, and video production workflows.
  • Excellent project organization and workflow management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and quality standards.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in media localization, entertainment, post-production, or digital content environments.
  • Knowledge of additional Adobe Creative Suite tools.
  • Experience implementing workflow improvements and creative best practices.

Why should you join us?

At Pixelogic, we pride ourselves on fostering a supportive and engaging environment. Our comprehensive benefits include top-notch medical and social insurance fully covered for you and your family, ongoing training and development opportunities, and fun department outings to boost team spirit. Enjoy delicious catered meals, unlimited snacks and drinks, and a fun office activity area for games and stress relief. We also provide free internet for remote work, convenient office transportation, and a rewarding referral bonus system.

title: Administrative Coordinator - Emirati Talent
description:

Key Responsibilities

📋 Administration & Operations

  • Coordinate daily office workflows, scheduling, and meeting logistics across departments
  • Prepare, review, and organize documents, reports, correspondence, and presentations in both Arabic and English
  • Maintain accurate digital and physical filing systems, ensuring easy retrieval and compliance with company standards
  • Track and process incoming communications, inquiries, and internal requests, routing them appropriately and following up to ensure timely resolution
  • Assist with onboarding, record-keeping, and internal coordination to support team efficiency

🤝 Stakeholder & Community Support

  • Serve as a professional point of contact for internal teams, owners, residents, and government entities
  • Support coordination with Owners’ Associations, community committees, and service providers — reflecting KAIZEN’s commitment to transparent, engaging community management

title: Associate Estimator - Power Delivery
description:
Why Paradigm:

Joining Paradigm means being part of a growing team that values input and creativity. If you are looking for a role where your contributions matter and you can truly impact the company's trajectory, the position of Estimator - Power Delivery may be the perfect fit for you.

Position Summary:

The Estimator - Power Delivery will be responsible for preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates for various power delivery projects. This role involves analyzing plans and specifications, conducting quantity take-offs, and collaborating with project teams to develop competitive and strategic bids.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Prepare detailed cost estimates by analyzing project specifications and performing quantity take-offs across trades, including high and low-voltage electrical, control systems, and structural elements.
  • Develop conceptual estimates using preliminary design documents, interacting closely with engineers and project managers.
  • Maintain a comprehensive database for labor and material pricing to ensure accurate future cost estimates.
  • Assist in managing the subcontractor RFP process by preparing bid packages and evaluating bids for scope alignment and competitiveness.
  • Support project teams with insights on estimating processes and assist during the project execution phase.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or related field preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in estimating, specifically within the power delivery or construction industry.
  • Strong understanding of commercial terms, estimating principles, and construction processes.
  • Proficiency in using estimating software tools, Microsoft Office Suite, and other relevant applications.
  • Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail to produce accurate estimates.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Paradigm offers comprehensive benefits that cover you and your family from day one, including vacation pay, holiday pay, 401K match, and wellness awards!

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Wellness Programs and Awards
  • Gym Reimbursement and Weight Loss Benefit
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Accounts

title: Program Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

As the Program Supervisor, you will work closely with the Program Director to lead and support the Supportive Housing outreach team. Your role will focus on empowering program participants to achieve independence and integrate into the community. By employing a strength-based approach, you will guide staff, ensuring they have the necessary resources and mentorship to succeed. Key responsibilities include supervising service delivery, monitoring staff performance, and maintaining compliance with all applicable regulations.

Pay Rate: $50,000 - $53,000 annually

Open Shift: Monday through Friday 9am-5pm (40hrs), some flexibility required

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and oversee program services such as assessments, treatment plans, crisis interventions, and implementation strategies.
  • Ensure all participant files, case notes, reports, and medication records are accurate, complete, and comply with organizational procedures.
  • Prepare progress reports and maintain HMIS (Homeless Management Information System) documentation.
  • Ensure timely submission of required reports and oversee program-related financial transactions.
  • Directly supervise 5-10 staff members, explaining and enforcing policies and procedures.
  • Provide training, support professional development, evaluate performance, and address personnel issues as needed.
  • Ensure adequate staffing levels to minimize overtime while meeting contractual requirements.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers to address participant health needs and respond promptly to incidents involving participants.
  • Conduct regular, documented supervision sessions focused on staff and program needs.
  • Lead effective team meetings to ensure collaboration and goal alignment.
  • Partner with the MHA Housing Specialist to support participant moves, including the completion of move-in checklists.
  • Represent the program in community-based provider meetings relevant to supportive housing.
  • Attend all required training sessions within the designated orientation period and as mandated thereafter.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation and provide after-hours support as needed.

About the Division of Supportive Housing (DSH)

The Division of Supportive Housing (DSH) provides safe, stable housing and individualized wraparound services for individuals who have experienced chronic homelessness, many of whom are also navigating challenges related to substance use, incarceration, or trauma. DSH programs focus on long-term stability and help participants transition to independent, permanent housing. Through person-centered care, housing navigation, and community-based supports, we empower individuals to build a foundation for recovery, self-sufficiency, and a better quality of life.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The Mental Health Association is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and access to a reliable, insured vehicle.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Flexibility to adapt to the evolving needs of program participants.
  • Compassionate and patient demeanor, with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (403B, IRA)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Long Term Disability
  • $50,000 - $53,000 annually

title: Global Influencer Relations Executive
description:
Who We Are

Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination’ in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona’s rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world’s most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long-lasting, and cruelty-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi-faceted jeweled bottles.

Our Mission

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.

Summary

We are seeking a Global Influencer Marketing Executive who is genuinely passionate about creators, with a strong understanding of creator culture, emerging talent and digital trends. You will play a key role in supporting KAYALI’s global influencer strategy, building meaningful creator relationships and identifying talent that authentically aligns with the KAYALI brand and community.

A core focus of the role will be owning the operational delivery of global influencer gifting and PR packages, including product and merchandise forecasting, supplier management, inventory and allocations, kitting, logistics and global shipping. Working closely with regional teams and cross-functional partners, you will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest standard, while supporting creator seeding, database management and performance tracking to continually grow and strengthen KAYALI’s global influencer community.

As a person, you are creative, social and positive, with a collaborative mindset and a natural ability to build strong relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Influencer Marketing & Seeding

· Identify and recommend relevant creators for gifting, seeding and organic brand opportunities.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, managers and agencies

Influencer Database & Reporting

· Support the ongoing management and growth of the global influencer database, ensuring creator information is accurate and regularly updated.

· Support reporting on gifting performance, coverage and EMV generated from influencer seeding initiatives.

PR Packages, Gifting & Logistics

· Own the end-to-end coordination of global influencer PR packages and gifting, from initial planning through to delivery.

· Support the development and execution of PR packages for KAYALI product launches and key brand moments.

· Manage global product and merchandise allocations for influencer gifting across priority markets.

· Coordinate closely with Supply Chain, Operations, warehouses and regional teams to ensure all gifting components are delivered, kitted and dispatched according to agreed timelines.

· Maintain detailed gifting and logistics trackers

· Ensure regional teams have clear gifting guidelines, timelines, allocations and shipping information.

· Liaise directly with external suppliers and vendors to support the development and production of influencer PR packages, gifting materials and branded merchandise.

· Manage supplier timelines from briefing and sampling through to production and delivery, ensuring all elements are delivered on time.

· Maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiencies, lead times and ways of working.

Forecasting & Inventory Planning

· Own and maintain the launch-by-launch influencer product and merchandise forecast.

· Work closely with the Global Influencer team and regional markets to forecast gifting quantities based on launch priorities.

· Consolidate regional forecasts and ensure sufficient stock is secured ahead of key launches.

· Maintain visibility of available influencer stock and proactively flag potential shortages or requirements.

· Act as a key point of contact between the Global Influencer team and regional teams for gifting, product allocations and logistics.

Budget Tracking

· Track and manage project spend across influencer gifting, PR packages, merchandise and logistics, ensuring activity remains within agreed budgets.

· Maintain up-to-date budget trackers

· Work closely with Finance, Procurement and suppliers to track quotes, POs, invoices and associated costs.

Adhoc

· Support the wider Global Influencer team with ad-hoc projects and priority initiatives.

Requirements

· 2-4+ years' experience within Influencer Marketing, PR, Communications or a related role, ideally within beauty, fragrance, fashion or luxury.

· Strong experience managing influencer gifting, PR mailers, product seeding or logistics.

· Proven experience working cross-functionally with logistics, supply chain, operations and warehouse teams, as well as external suppliers, vendors and fulfilment partners to deliver complex, time-sensitive campaigns.

· Highly organised with excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple launches and deadlines simultaneously.

· Comfortable working with forecasts, inventory quantities, trackers and large datasets.

· Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing global shipments, product allocations and creator information.

· Strong understanding of the influencer and social media landscape, particularly Instagram and TikTok.

· Experience working with influencer platforms, databases or CRM systems is beneficial.

· Confident communicator who is comfortable working cross-functionally and with multiple international markets.

· Passionate about beauty, fragrance, creators and the KAYALI community.

· Proven success in negotiating and managing strategic partnerships across multiple regions.

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence and build rapport at all organizational levels.

· Passion for luxury fragrances and understanding of the beauty industry landscape.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities.

· Fluent in English; additional language skills (Arabic, French) advantageous.

Benefits

· Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage

· Find your Magic Days

· Volunteer Day

· Birthday Leave

· Egg Freezing Benefits

· Employee discounts on all Kayali products

· Quarterly product gifting

KAYALI is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Shelter Assistant - Men's Shelter
description:
Shelter Assistants are responsible for providing services to clients in One80 Place’s shelters. Shelter Assistants are responsible for maintaining a safe, housing-focused, trauma informed environment as they work to support individuals who are experiencing homelessness move to permanent housing.


Full-time and part-time positions available.

title: 1st Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

The Residential Support Specialist plays a crucial role in creating a supportive and secure living environment for individuals with acquired brain injuries. This position promotes personal growth, independence, and community engagement, embodying MHA’s Core Values of Respect, Integrity, and Compassion, while adhering to all relevant policies and guidelines.

Pay Rate: $19-21 an hour

Open Shift:

- Sunday 7am-3pm, Monday through Wednesday 10am-2pm (20hrs)

- Saturday & Sunday 8am-4pm (16hrs)

Key Responsibilities

  • Communicate respectfully with participants to promote self-esteem, empowerment, and independence.
  • Assist with personal care, daily routines, meal preparation, and support participants in managing finances and transportation.
  • Facilitate access to community resources, teach self-advocacy skills, and implement individualized service plans.
  • Complete all required documentation, track progress, and report incidents, emergencies, or concerns promptly.
  • Maintain scheduling flexibility, participate in team meetings, and attend required trainings.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, collaborate with the team, and support program goals.

About New Ways Services – (ABI Division)

New Way is MHA’s residential and community-based program supporting individuals with acquired brain injuries (ABI) from trauma, stroke, or serious illness. Our team helps participants overcome physical, emotional, and cognitive challenges, build skills, and gain independence through personalized care, meaningful daily routines, and supportive homes in welcoming neighborhoods. With 24/7 support, nursing, clinical, and therapeutic services, we help participants reconnect with their communities, regain confidence, and live life to the fullest.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The Mental Health Association is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license, sufficient insurance, and a reliable vehicle.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing time and priorities effectively.
  • Flexibility to adapt to the evolving needs of participants.
  • Ability to provide personal care, including assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.
  • Willingness and ability to obtain certifications in medication administration (MAP), CPR, and first aid.
  • Minimum age of 18; high school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Six months of relevant experience preferred, especially with individuals with brain injuries or mental health challenges.

title: Animal Ambassador Lead Keeper
description:
Mission & Values


The Virginia Zoo, founded in 1901 and located in Norfolk, Virginia, is home to more than 700 animals representing over 150 species across 53 acres of outdoor habitats, the World of Reptiles, classrooms, and guest amenities. The Zoo is committed to inspiring our community to take action to save the world’s wildlife and their ecosystems. Our vision is a world where everyone values wildlife and the environment.


We prioritize the health, safety, and wellbeing of every animal in our care. We empower our community to protect wildlife and ecosystems locally and globally. We create meaningful experiences that inspire curiosity, learning, and stewardship. We uphold ethical standards in all operations, partnerships, and interactions. We foster a welcoming environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our mission. We work together—staff, volunteers, city partners, and community to advance shared goals.


Position Summary


The Lead Keeper of Animal Ambassadors provides daily leadership and advanced animal husbandry for the Ambassador Collection. This role delivers high-quality care, supports training and wellbeing programs, and oversees day-to-day workflow for the Animal Ambassador Team. The Lead Keeper works as part of a cohesive management team and reports to the Animal Ambassador Curator.


Essential Duties / Responsibilities

  • Ensures exemplary daily care, husbandry, enrichment, and wellbeing of all ambassador species in accordance with institutional policies, AZA standards, USDA regulations and species-specific best practices.
  • Works with Curator, veterinary staff, animal keeper staff, animal husbandry volunteers, interns and the conservation engagement team to ensure the highest standards of animal care.
  • Assists in medical procedures, routine health checks, quarantine protocols as directed and participates in vet rounds when applicable.
  • Performs administrative duties by keeping records on animal behavior and exhibit repairs, maintaining inventory, filling out paperwork and surveys, serving as the Institutional Representative for various SSP’s, conducting research when requested, preparing reports and presenting findings, and attending meetings.
  • Pursues opportunities to participate in workshops, seminars, activities and conferences aimed at continually improving job knowledge and professional development with the goal of benefitting the Animal Ambassador Team.
  • Assists the Curator with evaluations and performance reviews for Animal Ambassador Specialists, guest engagement staff, interns and volunteers.
  • Assists with departmental hiring including recruitment and training of staff and interns.
  • Assists with scheduling, workflow planning, and task delegation.
  • Initiates diet change requests, new enrichment proposals, husbandry change proposals and work order requests.
  • Organizes daily and weekly operations of the team's projects and goals, including creating and maintenance of their areas’ standard operating procedures.
  • Maintains excellent written and verbal communication with co-workers, managers, and veterinary staff.
  • Responsible for accurate observation, evaluation and documentation of animal behaviors and the oversight of daily animal training.
  • Evaluates all activities with regards to husbandry, medical, enrichment, handling and public presentations.
  • Schedules daily husbandry assignments for both staff and volunteers.
  • Assists with managing departmental supplies and major projects.
  • Serves as point of contact in Curator’s absence and oversees maintenance/contractor work in their completion using designated procedures.
  • Assists in developing and maintaining animal handling policies for non-animal care staff and oversees handling training for staff and volunteers.
  • Ensures all programs adhere to safety and institutional and animal wellbeing standards.
  • Assist with collection planning, species evaluations and ambassador program expansion or modification.
  • Actively participates in improving area policies, procedures, and protocols to ensure high standards of care for the collection and the safety of staff and guests.
  • Demonstrates initiative towards continually improving advanced keeper duties including excellent animal care and guest interactions.
  • Demonstrates the ability to meet challenges with a solution-oriented approach and encourage staff to do the same.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Associate' degree in biology or related field.
  • At least 5 years of progressive experience working with zoological animals required.
  • Experience in animal training using positive reinforcement techniques required.
  • Knowledge of zoology and informal education required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Ability to work with individuals and groups of all ages.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completion of a 4-year bachelor’s degree or a 2-year associate degree from an accredited college with a dedicated zookeeping or wildlife program.
  • Five years or more working as a full-time zookeeper in an AZA accredited institution.
  • Experience presenting animal ambassadors to the public.
  • Experience in working with interns and volunteers.

Physical Requirements / Working Conditions

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times.
  • Frequent walking, standing, reaching with hands and arms, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, talking, and hearing.
  • Able to work indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Ability to maintain a professional appearance and conduct

Special Requirements


· Valid driver’s license

· Ability to pass a background check

· Must participate in a health screening program


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement


The Virginia Zoo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to

creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration

for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual

orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.


ADA Accommodation Statement


The Virginia Zoo is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with

disabilities to ensure equal access to employment opportunities and the essential functions of each

position. Applicants or employees who require accommodation may contact Human Resources to

initiate an interactive process.

title: Sanitation Tech I - Night Shift
description:
Our Sanitation Techs are a cornerstone to our success as a plant--both to ensure a safe & clean facility, but also for the advancement of our processes and pushing benchmarks for our Master Sanitation schedule. While this role requires basic cleaning procedures and common plant auditing, ideal candidates will succeed on our team if they enjoy variety and are driven by a sense of accomplishment. We are also looking for team members who bring an open mind for learning and continuous improvement.

Must be willing to be boom lift/manlift certified, heights up to 30ft.

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Ensuring that Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) guidelines are adhered to
  • Follow cleaning procedures using established benchmarks and SSOPs
  • Monitor waste water production and reduction
  • Assist all production areas in sanitation practices
  • Washing all plant equipment as required.
  • Ensure compliance with production and industry standards (USFDA, NOP Organic)
  • Process tasks under the Pest Management Action Plan
  • Participate in monthly internal plant audits and Continuous Improvement teams

  • Calling for cardboard, trash, plastic, and wastewater

  • Working in a team environment to decrease production downtime

Path for Success:

  • High school diploma or GED preferred
  • Ability to pass in-house certification tests for operation scissor lifts and boom trucks
  • Basic math and computer skills required
  • The ability to communicate and understand verbal directions effectively and efficiently in the English language, both verbal and written

Wage: $21.06-$22.67/hr + $1.50/hr shift differential between 6PM - 6AM

Shift: 4 on/4 off 6PM-6:30AM

Benefits and Perks:

  • $1,000 sign-on bonus! (New employees only, not valid for individuals previously employed within the last 5 years)
  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision and Dental insurance plans, including employer paid options – 3 plans to choose from
  • Complimentary Life and Disability plans
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Hospital Indemnity, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, and Critical Illness Insurance
  • Get Fit reimbursement program towards fitness/wellness, (up to $300/yr)
  • Employee Discount on Nature's Path Products
  • 401(k) Savings and with the company match of up to 4%
  • Vacation and Sick Time
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Maternal Salary Continuance
  • Monthly attendance incentive - $80
  • Night Shift Differential - $1.50/hour
  • Green my Ride program
  • Clean Energy Vehicle Program - $1000/ every 5 years
  • Team Member Referral Bonus - $1000
  • $145 annual shoe allowance through our Online Safety Shoe Program

Candidate Screening & Interview Process

All applicants who meet the qualifications for this position are encouraged to apply. Upon submission of your application, you may be invited to participate in a preliminary telephone or virtual interview with a member of our People & Culture team. Successful candidates will proceed to in-person interviews with the Hiring Manager(s) and a member of People & Culture.

Other requirements:

  • Willingness to complete an online assessment test.
  • Willingness to complete a panel drug screening and background check upon hire.
  • Must be at 18 years old or older at the time of hire.

title: Director of Enterprise Applications
description:
The Director of Enterprise Applications is responsible for the strategy, governance, and operational leadership of the company's global enterprise application landscape. This role oversees the performance, support, and continuous improvement of business-critical platforms, including SAP ECC 6, CRM, business intelligence, process mining, AI-enabled business solutions, and other enterprise applications.

Reporting to the Vice President of Information Technology, the Director will lead a global team while managing key third-party technology partners to ensure reliable operations and successful delivery of strategic initiatives. A primary responsibility will be preparing the organization for a future migration to SAP S/4HANA while partnering closely with business leaders to optimize processes and leverage emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Applications Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's roadmap for migration to SAP S/4HANA over the coming years.
  • Lead ERP implementation projects from planning through deployment while managing scope, budgets, timelines, risks, and vendor performance.

Business Applications & Digital Transformation

Provide strategic oversight for enterprise applications including:

  • CRM platforms
  • Business Intelligence and reporting solutions
  • Process mining platforms (Celonis)
  • Workflow and automation tools
  • AI-enabled business applications
  • Other enterprise software supporting global operations

Identify opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence and automation to improve operational efficiency, user productivity, and business decision-making.

Leadership & Vendor Management

  • Lead a global applications organization of approximately 10 team members located in the United States and India.
  • Manage the outsourced SAP support partner consisting of approximately seven consultants.
  • Coach, develop, and mentor technical staff while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.
  • Manage relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and consulting firms.
  • Establish performance metrics and ensure service delivery meets business expectations.

Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related discipline.
  • Approximately 20-25 years of progressive IT experience, including significant enterprise applications leadership.
  • Extensive experience leading SAP ECC environments in complex global organizations.
  • Experience managing outsourced SAP support providers and global support organizations.

  • Experience with enterprise business applications such as CRM, Business Intelligence, reporting platforms, and workflow solutions.

Preferred

title: Intern - Foundation
description:
Position: Intern – Foundation

Atlanta Track Club is a nonprofit committed to creating an active and healthy Atlanta. Through running and walking, Atlanta Track Club motivates, inspires and engages the community to enjoy a healthier lifestyle.

With 45,000 members, Atlanta Track Club is the second largest running organization in the United States. In addition to the Northside Hospital Peachtree Road Race – the world’s largest road race 10K road race unning nt in the world, the Northside Hospital Polar Opposite Peachtree Road Race, the Atlanta Marathon, PNC Atlanta 10 Miler and Invesco QQQ Thanksgiving Day Half Marathon, Atlanta Track Club directs more than 30 events per year. Through the support of its members and volunteers, Atlanta Track Club also maintains a number of community initiatives including organizing and promoting the Kilometer Kids youth running program to metro Atlanta youth, honoring high school cross country and track and field athletes through Atlanta Track Club's All-Metro Banquets. For more information on Atlanta Track Club, visit atlantatrackclub.org.


Position Overview: Reporting to the Associate Director – Foundation, the Foundation Intern plays a hands-on role supporting Atlanta Track Club's Foundation's fundraising and donor engagement efforts across the organization's signature giving programs, including an annual campaign and charity fundraising. title: Intermediate Software Engineer
description:
Innovative Signal Analysis (ISA) is seeking new engineering talent with an emphasis on intuitive user-facing application development, scalable services, database architecture, and robust data/signal integration pipelines. ISA is a leading provider of real-time signal and image processing systems for the government and remains dedicated to the development of high-performance signal processing solutions. ISA works in all phases from concept design, through development and integration, to operations and maintenance of challenging mission critical systems, with offices in Richardson, TX & Aurora, CO.

Responsibilities
Intermediate Software Engineers support the complete lifecycle of software intensive distributed computing signal processing systems to include design, development, integration, validation and verification, installation, and maintenance in accordance with ISA engineering processes. Engineers work in a collaborative multi-disciplined team environment including software, systems, and signal processing engineers. This entails producing and capturing various design, implementation and test artifacts; participating in peer reviews of such artifacts; supporting the integration of these artifacts into the system(s) under construction; supporting the installation of these systems at ISA factories as well as customer facilities; responding to change requests and defect reports from installed systems. Intermediate Software Engineers will work on open-ended tasks and are expected to self-start some tasks, working independently or with minimal supervision. Required Skills:

  • C/C++, Python, Linux, Agile Processes, Version Control (Git)

Desired Skills:

Intermediate Software Engineers are expected to have exposure to most of these listed and should be proficient in some:

  • Cloud-Native Messaging (RabbitMQ, NATS, AMQP)
  • REST API Development (OpenAPI, Contract Testing)
  • TCP/IP Networking (particularly for Cloud/Edge networking)
  • Continuous Integration / DevOps (Gitlab, Nexus, SonarQube, Test Frameworks)

We offer a compensation package that includes a competitive base salary plus annual performance bonus and benefits. title: Safety Coordinator
description:
Safety isn't just paperwork—and neither is this job.

Milford is growing, and we're looking for an organized, detail-driven Safety Coordinator to help keep our employees trained, our safety programs moving, and our customer compliance requirements on track.

This position serves as a central point for safety documentation, employee training coordination, incident follow-up, contractor compliance systems, and other safety-related administrative functions.

If you're someone who can keep a lot of moving pieces organized, follow through until something is actually finished, and communicate comfortably with employees, managers, vendors, and customers, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate safety and compliance activities across multiple Milford locations
  • Track required employee safety training, certifications, renewals, and expiration dates
  • Schedule internal and third-party training and help identify cost-effective training options
  • Maintain customer and contractor safety/compliance systems and required documentation
  • Assist HR with developing, updating, communicating, and maintaining safety policies and procedures
  • Gather information and documentation following workplace injuries and incidents
  • Coordinate required post-accident testing with HR
  • Follow up with third-party administrators and obtain authorized medical documentation when needed
  • Maintain accurate safety, incident, training, and compliance records
  • Help identify upcoming training or compliance requirements before they become problems
  • Work with managers to resolve missing documentation, overdue training, and other safety-related items
  • Support Milford's continued development of consistent safety processes across the organization

What We're Looking For

  • Prior experience in safety, EHS, compliance, training coordination, HR/safety administration, or a related field
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Excellent follow-through—you don't need someone reminding you that something is still outstanding
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working with employees and managers at all levels of the organization
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, locations, systems, and priorities
  • Comfortable working with online customer and contractor compliance platforms
  • Strong computer and documentation skills
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately
  • OSHA 10 certification is required after hire and will be provided/paid for by Milford

The Right Person

You don't have to know every answer on day one.

We need someone who is organized, accountable, comfortable asking questions, willing to learn, and persistent enough to chase down the answer when something isn't complete.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys the administrative and coordination side of safety but also wants the opportunity to help improve how a growing company manages safety, training, and compliance.

Location & Travel

This is primarily an office-based position with minimal travel. The position may be based in Midland or the Dallas–Fort Worth area, with remote eligibility depending on the candidate and business needs.

title: Program Assistant at Otto's Place
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION: The Program Assistant observes, records, and responds as needed to the comings and goings of guests/residents/participants and staff, and maintains a safe and comfortable environment, to respond to issues as appropriate. They serve as a member of the program services team; they support and work with them to serve the community by providing trauma-informed assistance. This is a unionized position, represented by Local 8 of the Office and Professional Employees International Union (OPEIU).

ABOUT THE PROGRAM: Otto’s Place Enhanced Shelter removes barriers for individuals transitioning out of homelessness by combining overnight shelter with 24/7 on-site support services and intensive case management, behavioral clinician, including housing navigation. In addition to services, we offer 100 individual sleeping areas for male-identifying guests, meals, laundry, and service pets. This combination of shelter and services enables us to meet people where they are and build a supportive community to help people currently living in tents or encampments to move toward stability. Referrals are directed by the City of Seattle’s Hope Team.

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION: Compass Housing Alliance develops and provides essential services, shelter, and affordable housing so that everyone in our community has a safe place to call home. We envision a world in which every person lives in a safe and caring community. Compass offers an open, supportive, and challenging work environment committed to promoting the dignity and well-being of each person that we serve. We recognize the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to the organization. We expect all employees to make efforts in their work and in their conduct to be welcoming to all. As of 2026, Compass Housing Alliance is a division of Lutheran Community Services Northwest (LCSNW). After years of affiliation and partnership, Compass and LCSNW joined together as one organization aligned in our shared values: compassion, love, health, justice, and hope. By combining LCSNW’s network of health and human services and Compass’s expertise in affordable housing and emergency services, we can provide holistic support to the communities we serve.

  • LOCATION: Pioneer Square Neighborhood (Seattle, WA)
  • REPORTS TO: Program Supervisor
  • FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt
  • SCHEDULE: Sunday-Thursday 8am-4pm with biweekly staff meeting Thursdays 1-2pm
  • MEAL PERIOD: Paid (30-minutes)
  • SALARY: $25.24 per hour (Step 1*)
  • *Step 2 increase of 2.5% after 12 consecutive months of employment

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. The employee in this position must be able to read, write, and understand English.


Direct Services

  • Provide trauma-informed monitoring of activity in and around the building to ensure safety, security, and comfort of guests/residents/participants and staff.
  • Mediate conflicts and provide de-escalation and crisis intervention; model appropriate problem solving and refer to appropriate services as needed.
  • Assist in support of program activities. Including meal services, assisting guests/residents/participants with tasks such as laundry access and/or instruction, group activities, or other similar activities.
  • Engage guests/residents/participants to assess needs providing immediate and appropriate information and referrals.
  • Respond to guests/residents/participants issues as appropriate or as directed by program management and/or property management.
  • Report guest/resident/participant and/or building needs to management and ensure supply/equipment is in stock for use.
  • Monitor security cameras, make periodic security rounds of the building, check lights, doors, and windows, and investigate noise and other complaints.
  • Log all actions, incidents, rule enforcements, and report unusual or sensitive matters to the Program Coordinator and/or Manager.
  • Control after-hours front door/access and monitor guest/resident/participant log enforcing rules and restrictions.
  • Follow building/staff safety and emergency procedures according to program and agency policies.
  • Perform light janitorial duties, as assigned.

Leadership

  • Recognize the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to the organization.
  • Maintain a favorable working relationship with all other agency employees to foster and promote a cooperative and harmonious working climate.
  • Project a favorable image of the organization to promote its aims and objectives and foster and enhance public recognition and acceptance of all its areas of endeavor.
  • Perform all duties and responsibilities in a timely and effective manner in accordance with established agency policies to achieve the overall objectives of this position.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality, tactfulness, and respect for participants from diverse backgrounds and identities.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of best practices in de-escalation, crisis intervention, and stabilization skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of local resources and services for individuals who are experiencing homelessness or housing instability.
  • Manage difficult interpersonal situations effectively and know when to seek out support from your manager when needed.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions and crisis situations.
  • Ability to set and maintain boundaries in a professional manner.
  • Ability to follow agency policy and procedures to maintain safety and security within the facility.
  • Follow sound interpersonal boundaries and emotional intelligence.
  • Relate openly and comfortably with people from all backgrounds while valuing different points of views.
  • Promote a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences.
  • Work independently and as part of a team, particularly to exercise sound decision making in the absence of supervision, with strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to communicate effectively about technical problems and solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills are required to be successful in this role.
  • Aptitude for learning new technology skills with Microsoft products and other internet-based software.
  • Ability to learn new functions on office equipment and devices (printer, scanner, projector, mailing machine, copier).

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • At least 1 year of experience in a social/human service setting, preferred.
  • Awareness and/or training around belonging, compassion, and meeting people where they are, preferred.
  • Familiarity with topics of housing instability, mental health, substance use, sexual assault, and/or domestic violence, preferred.
  • Fluent ability to read, write, and understand English, required.
  • Experience working in an environment where language may be a barrier, preferred.
  • Current WA State Food Handlers Permit, preferred (If not current, will be sponsored within 1-month of hire).
  • Work experience is a key factor for success in this role. In addition, success in this role requires a passion for knowledge and drive for continuing professional development or education. A degree in human/social services or related field would be a complement to the required experience.

title: AI Data & Insights Officer
description:
AI Data & Insights Officer (FTC)
Borough, South London (SE1 1EP)

Worldwide Events Group

Worldwide Events Group, founded in 2004, is a recognised leader in global MICE and luxury travel. Across our portfolio, we bring people together and facilitate meaningful relationships, a philosophy we call H2H, human‑to‑human connection. Innovation drives our evolution. We’re embracing AI to elevate personalisation, streamline event design and create smarter, more intuitive experiences for our global communities.

Our work is delivered through two industry‑leading brands, each serving a distinct global community.

Private Luxury Events: Expect the Extraordinary

Private Luxury Events delivers world‑class experiences to the luxury travel community through its event brands Amour, Private Luxury, TFest and Ultra. Our ethos has always been to put the human experience first. This mantra has powered some of the most respected events in the industry, inspiring thousands of luxury travel professionals around the world and at the heart of everything we do lies a passion for connecting people.

M&I

M&I brings together high-calibre meeting planners and exhibitors from the hospitality industry through a series of standout events across Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. Our portfolio includes M&I Expo, M&I Flagship, M&I Healthcare, and M&I Luxe. We create beautifully crafted events that spark meaningful engagement, from curated 1-2-1 meetings to immersive moments that showcase exceptional destinations, hotels, venues and MICE services. Our events take place across Europe, the Americas and the Middle East in some of the world's most extraordinary destinations.

The Role

The AI Data & Insights Officer is responsible for turning WWE's business data into reliable insight, reusable intelligence and measurable value. Working within Agent Factory, you will ensure that AI agents, automations and decision-makers can access accurate, well-structured and actionable information.

You will work across Salesforce, event platforms, marketing systems, operational tools and AI knowledge sources to improve data quality, build analytical capabilities, support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), identify commercial opportunities and measure the performance of deployed agents.

This is a hands-on, business-facing role at the intersection of data analysis, business intelligence, AI enablement and commercial decision-making.

This is an initial six-month fixed-term contract opportunity, with the potential for extension, reporting to the Head of AI Implementation.

Responsibilities

Data & Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain datasets, models and insights that support AI agents and business decision-making.
  • Consolidate, cleanse and structure information from Salesforce, event platforms, marketing systems and operational tools.
  • Define practical data-quality, metadata and governance standards for information used by Agent Factory.
  • Identify trends, risks and commercial or operational opportunities within WWE datasets.
  • Support secure, reliable data flows between approved systems and agent solutions.

AI & Agent Enablement

  • Create and maintain knowledge bases and retrieval structures that improve agent accuracy and usefulness.
  • Support the design, testing and optimisation of RAG capabilities across the Agent Factory ecosystem.
  • Prepare evaluation datasets and test cases for assessing agent outputs.
  • Work with Agent Engineers and Agentic Capability Engineers to translate business data into reusable agent skills, tools and intelligence services.
  • Monitor data-related failure patterns and recommend improvements to source content, retrieval and agent behaviour.

Analytics & Performance

  • Design dashboards, scorecards and reporting that provide meaningful visibility of business performance.
  • Define and track measures for agent adoption, accuracy, time saved, operational impact and commercial value.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and return on investment of AI agents and automations.
  • Develop actionable insight for leadership and business teams rather than producing reporting for its own sake.
  • Establish repeatable methods for monitoring and communicating the value created by Agent Factory.

Commercial & Operational Insight

  • Develop insight that supports customer retention, buyer and supplier engagement, sales effectiveness, event performance and workflow improvement.
  • Explore predictive and segmentation approaches where they can support better business decisions.
  • Turn analytical findings into clear recommendations, prioritised opportunities and defined next actions.
  • Help teams move from descriptive reporting towards decision intelligence and next-best-action capabilities.

Business Partnering

  • Work with departments across WWE to understand their data, reporting and insight requirements.
  • Translate business questions into clear analytical work and practical data products.
  • Present complex findings in a concise, accessible way to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Promote responsible, evidence-led use of data and AI across the organisation.
  • Document analytical methods, data definitions and reusable assets so capabilities can scale.

Due to the nature of our work, you may occasionally be required to work outside standard hours to support events or meet key deadlines

Requirements

You’ll thrive in this AI Data and Insights Officer role if you bring:

  • Professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics engineering or a closely related role.
  • Strong experience of data preparation, cleansing, modelling and quality assurance.
  • Experience using SQL and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience working with CRM, customer, commercial or operational data; Salesforce experience is particularly relevant.
  • Ability to combine information from multiple systems and work effectively with APIs or structured data integrations.
  • Strong understanding of KPI design, dashboarding and the communication of actionable insight.
  • Ability to translate complex evidence into clear business recommendations.
  • Excellent problem-solving, critical-thinking and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Sound understanding of data privacy, access control and responsible use of business information.
  • Curiosity about AI, automation and the practical application of emerging technology.

title: WordPress Developer (Elementor Expert)
description:

Reports To: Director of Design & Development
Team: Web Development / Delivery

The Opportunity

Intellibright is looking for a mid-level WordPress Developer with expert-level Elementor experience to help build, optimize, and maintain high-performing marketing websites and landing pages for our clients.

If you move fast without breaking things, care about clean implementation, and know how to get the most out of Elementor (Theme Builder, global systems, dynamic content, performance)—this role is for you. You’ll work closely with designers, strategists, SEO, and paid media teams to ship conversion-focused experiences that are measurable and reliable.

This is a 6-month contract-to-hire role with a hybrid schedule requiring in-office collaboration 3 days per week.

About Intellibright

Intellibright is a performance-driven digital marketing agency built around accountability and close client partnerships. We believe that if something does not tie back to revenue, it does not matter.

Our proprietary revenue analytics connect marketing activity to pipeline, sales, and revenue across channels.

Recognized by Inc. 5000 and the Financial Times 500 as one of the fastest growing companies in the Americas five years running, Intellibright is a high performance agency headquartered in Austin, Texas.

What You Will Own

What Success Looks Like

At Intellibright, strong strategy only creates value if it is executed well.

This role ensures our web experiences—often the center of a client’s acquisition and conversion funnel—are built with speed, precision, and performance in mind. The WordPress Developer (Elementor Expert) turns creative and marketing direction into real, measurable outcomes by shipping pages that load fast, track correctly, and convert.

Nice to Have
