title: Mental Health Clinical Director
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM AS A CLINICAL DIRECTOR!

At Crownview Co-Occurring Institute (CCI) and Crownview Psychiatric Institute (CPI), we are dedicated to transforming lives through compassionate, evidence-based mental health care. We are seeking an experienced, dynamic, and mission-driven Clinical Director to provide strong clinical leadership, manage and develop our clinical team, and oversee the delivery of high-quality psychiatric and behavioral health services.

If you are a licensed mental health professional with a passion for clinical leadership, staff supervision, team development, and clinical excellence, we invite you to join an organization where your expertise will make a meaningful impact every day.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Clinical Director provides strategic, clinical, and operational leadership for all clinical and therapeutic services across the organization. This position is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and management of the clinical team, ensuring that clinicians and clinical staff have the direction, supervision, resources, and support necessary to provide exceptional client care.

The Clinical Director ensures the delivery of high-quality, ethical, evidence-based, and compliant behavioral health services while fostering a collaborative, accountable, client-centered culture.

This position partners closely with executive leadership and is responsible for leading, supervising, evaluating, mentoring, and developing the clinical team, while overseeing clinical operations, regulatory compliance, staff performance, program quality, clinical documentation, and continuous performance improvement.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

As Clinical Director, you will:

Clinical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, manage, and oversee the clinical and therapeutic team, providing clear direction, expectations, accountability, and support.
  • Provide direct leadership and oversight to licensed clinicians, therapists, and other clinical staff.
  • Mentor, supervise, evaluate, and develop clinical team members.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold clinical staff accountable for professional standards, quality of care, documentation, and organizational policies.
  • Conduct regular clinical team meetings, individual supervision, case consultation, and performance discussions.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, professionalism, clinical excellence, and continuous learning.
  • Identify staff strengths, development opportunities, and training needs and implement strategies to strengthen the clinical team.
  • Address clinical performance concerns promptly and collaborate with Human Resources regarding coaching, corrective action, performance improvement plans, and other employee relations matters.
  • Serve as a visible and accessible clinical leader who supports staff while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries and accountability.

Clinical Supervision & Professional Development

  • Provide ongoing clinical supervision to assigned clinical staff in accordance with applicable California licensing requirements and organizational standards.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain individualized clinical supervision plans based on licensure requirements, professional development needs, and clinical competencies.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of clinical supervision.
  • Provide case consultation and guidance regarding complex clinical presentations, treatment planning, risk assessment, crisis situations, and appropriate interventions.
  • Support clinicians in developing sound clinical judgment and maintaining ethical and professional standards.
  • Monitor supervision requirements and assist clinical staff in maintaining licensure and professional competency.
  • Coordinate and facilitate at least 20 hours of annual in-service training for clinical staff, including clinical, regulatory, documentation, and professional development topics.
  • Identify opportunities for ongoing education, leadership development, and advancement within the clinical team.

Clinical Quality & Program Oversight

  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality clinical and therapeutic services.
  • Monitor and improve the quality of clinical care, including assessments, individual therapy, group therapy, treatment planning, progress documentation, discharge planning, and clinical coordination.
  • Conduct regular clinical chart audits and provide feedback and coaching to clinicians to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant electronic health record documentation.
  • Monitor clinical outcomes, documentation standards, treatment effectiveness, and adherence to established clinical practices.
  • Develop and implement clinical policies, procedures, workflows, and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities for program improvement and implement strategies to improve clinical outcomes and operational efficiency.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and maintain Joint Commission and regulatory readiness.
  • Ensure clinical services are delivered in accordance with applicable California laws, licensing requirements, accreditation standards, ethical standards, and organizational policies.

Collaboration & Organizational Leadership

  • Partner closely with executive leadership regarding clinical operations, staffing, program development, clinical quality, and organizational strategy.
  • Collaborate with physicians, interventionists, referral partners, attorneys, consultants, community providers, and other members of the multidisciplinary team.
  • Work collaboratively with Business Development regarding site tours, referral relationships, and presentation of clinical programs and services.
  • Participate in leadership meetings and contribute clinical expertise to organizational decision-making.
  • Develop and implement strategic initiatives that strengthen clinical programming, staff performance, client outcomes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Serve as a clinical representative of the organization with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Promote effective communication and collaboration between clinical, medical, operations, admissions, business development, and other departments.


WHY JOIN CROWNVIEW?

At Crownview, you'll become part of a multidisciplinary team dedicated to helping adults living with psychiatric disorders achieve meaningful recovery. We believe exceptional client care begins with exceptional clinical leadership.

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Professional development and continuing education support
  • Leadership development opportunities
  • Collaborative and supportive workplace culture
  • Opportunity to shape clinical programs and drive organizational excellence
  • Opportunity to lead, mentor, and develop a growing clinical team

OUR CLIENTS:

Our programs serve adults (18+) experiencing psychiatric disorders as defined by the DSM-5. We provide compassionate, evidence-based treatment in a collaborative and recovery-oriented environment.


APPLY TODAY!

If you're ready to lead and develop a dedicated clinical team, provide meaningful clinical supervision, influence the future of behavioral healthcare, and make a lasting impact on the lives of clients and staff, we'd love to hear from you.

Crownview Co-Occurring Institute & Crownview Psychiatric Institute are Equal Opportunity Employers committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee and client is treated with dignity and respect.


Salaried, exempt $125,000 - $150,000 d.o.e

title: Global Security Specialist [L4] (GSOC Ops and Readiness)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 Global Security Operations Center(이하 GSOC)는 위기관리센터로서 내외부 위험에 대한 실시간 모니터링을 제공하고 사건/사고 발생시 위기관리 프로세스에 따라 신속한 대응을 주도하여 직원의 안전을 보장하고 비즈니스 운영의 연속성을 지원합니다. 회사에서 일어날 수 있는 다양한 사건, 사고에 대처하기 위해 24시간 365일 운영되며 사건/사고 발생시 해당 사건, 사고를 빠른 시간내에 전파하고 이를 해결할 수 있는 적절한 지원이 이뤄지도록 합니다.

업무 내용

  • Global Security 부서의 커뮤니케이션 허브 역할
  • 모니터링 시스템을 통해 인지된 다양한 리스크 및 사건사고 접수 및 적시 대응
  • 글로벌 이벤트 모니터링 및 영향 평가 후 GSOC의 파트너들에게 공유
  • 회사 운영, 임직원, 시설 및 고객에게 영향을 미칠 수 있는 외부 위협에 대한 인지, 위험성 평가 및 분류
  • 공급망 자산과 관련된 위험 모니터링 후 전달
  • GSOC Supervisor(Manager) 업무 지원

고용형태

  • 정규직
  • 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 진행

자격 요건

  • 비상관리, 안전관리, 환경, 경영, 경제, 커뮤니케이션, 정보기술, 정치 과학, 공학, 지리학, 경비학 등의 전공의 학사학위를 보유하신 분
  • 우수한 커뮤니케이션 기술을 통해 서면(필요시 구두)으로 경영진 수준과 의사소통 할 수 있는 능력이 있으신 분
  • 높은 스트레스 및 시간제약이 있는 상황에서 멀티태스킹이 가능하신 분
  • 모호한 상황에서도 비판적으로 분석하고 사고하시는 분
  • 스스로 동기를 부여하고 대응력이 뛰어나며, 적극적이며 끝까지 작업을 주도하실 수 있는 분
  • 주/야 및 주말 스케줄 근무 가능하신 분
  • 중급 이상의 영어 회화가 가능하신 분

우대 사항

  • 산업안전/EHS/물리 보안/군사/SOC(Security Operations Center)/관제/리스크관리/고객대응 등 관련 업계에 3년 이상 근무 경험을 가지신 분
  • 글로벌 이벤트와 글로벌 지리/문화에 대한 실무지식이 있으신 분
  • 컴퓨터 지식과 기술, 복잡한 플랫폼 작업을 경험하신 분
  • IT, 정보, 기업, 군사 또는 보안 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화 면접 - 대면 면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동 될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다 .
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류반환정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Monadnock Construction, Inc. is a leading general contractor in New York City, specializing in large scale, multifamily residential construction projects. Known for our commitment to quality building, safety, and innovation, we take pride in building high-performance teams dedicated to delivering top-tier results. We are seeking a Technical Trainer to enhance the skills and knowledge of our workforce, including laborers and field based management staff.

Position Overview:

The Technical Trainer will be responsible for developing and delivering training programs that enhance the construction skills, safety awareness, and technical capabilities of our field workforce. This role will focus on improving competencies in safety standards, trade-specific skills, equipment use, and construction operations. The Technical Trainer will partner with our in house Safety team, operations teams, and foremen to ensure our teams have the training needed to execute high-quality work while maintaining safety on job sites.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver training sessions that focus on core construction skills and safety enforcement per OSHA and NCCER standards (including but not limited to general labor tasks, carpentry, masonry, mechanical and electrical trades, scaffolding, fireproofing, waterproofing, tools and equipment operation/safety, and emergency preparedness).
  • Coordinate with VP of Safety Operations, General Labor Foreman, and Executives to coordinate topics and maintain a rolling schedule.
  • Utilize trusted subcontractors and 3rd party consultants when needed for specific topic training.
  • Lead training on OSHA and all required DOB certifications. Additionally, partner with field supervisors and foremen to assess job-specific training needs, and develop custom training for various job sites and projects.
  • Use feedback from management staff to evaluate the performance of trainees to identify knowledge gaps and areas for improvement. Ensure the continuous development of the workforce.
  • Create and maintain up-to-date training materials and plans that align with industry and company standards.
  • Develop methods of testing the efficacy of the training, ensuring that participants have successfully completed and meet Monadnock standards.
  • Keep up with the latest trends in construction technology, equipment, and best practices, integrating new knowledge into training programs to enhance employee skills.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in NYC building construction with some experience in training, education, or mentoring others in construction.
  • OSHA 500 and NCCER certifications are strongly preferred, but not required to start. Monadnock will sponsor required certifications.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to engage, teach, and motivate a workforce with varying levels of experience and expertise.
  • In-depth knowledge of construction processes, tools, materials, and safety protocols, specifically in NYC construction. Thorough knowledge of DOB requirements/regulations.
  • Prior experience in creating effective training programs in a construction environment preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred.

Salary range: $110,000 - $150,000 annually

The salary range posted is the base salary only and not the total compensation package.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Company Bonus Program
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Wellness Resources

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for maintaining a weekly department schedule that assigns staff to client shifts that will maximize the clients budgeted hours, staff retention and profitability. The coordinator complete schedules in a timely manner, making adjustments as needed in real time, and communicating with staff effectively. We are looking for 1 FT and 1 PT person to fill this position. The hours will be Monday-Friday with on call every other weekend and the possibility to cover a shift if needed.


DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain accurate schedules.
  • Utilize electronic scheduling software.
  • Assign staff to available shifts based upon staff’s availability/client need.
  • Alter schedules to reassign staff to mandated shifts as needed and notify staff of the changes.
  • Serve as point of contact for staff to schedule, change, and/or cancel shifts.
  • Serve as point of contact for staff for call-offs during scheduled work hours.
  • Forecast census for staffing.
  • Compile and analyze monthly data related to client hours, staff hours, overtime, and contract utilization.
  • Evaluate scheduling alternatives to support Service Authorization changes and maximize profitability.
  • Be available as scheduled, or as needed, to receive emergency communication during non-traditional work times. Required to carry on-call phone two weekends a month.
  • Complete clerical duties, which include but not limited to; Assist with maintaining the staff availability binder and making necessary monthly changes to the transportation schedule as it relates to shift changes.
  • Schedule necessary training for the Direct Support Professionals.
  • Serve as Direct Support Professional as needed during traditional and non-traditional work times while on call, when call offs cannot be covered.

title: Program Manager, Operations - Tamil Nadu
description:
About Mitti Labs

Mitti Labs is a climate-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.

Backed by NASA-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net-zero goals through verified, high-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.

Our customers - including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri-businesses - trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.

Role Description

Mitti Labs is entering Tamil Nadu as we expand our climate-smart agriculture programs across key rice-growing regions. We are looking for a strong, strategic state lead/project lead who can build and manage Tamil Nadu operations from inception and ensure seamless execution of our carbon projects.

Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.

Some of your objectives will include:

  • Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre-defined roadmap
  • Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
  • Continually training, re-training, and supporting the field agent force
  • Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?

We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. External Partner Operations Management

  • Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
  • Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
  • Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
  • Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc.
  • Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner’s teams (at managerial and operational levels)
  • Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks

2. Internal Communications

  • Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
  • Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
  • Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
  • Offer support on Science Ops, R&D ops, agronomic demos, etc.

3. Operational Execution and Leadership

  • Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on-ground execution
  • Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
  • Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
  • Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
  • Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
  • Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
  • Build marketing material in coordination with on-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
  • Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs + Video walkthroughs

Requirements

Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:

  • Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
  • Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
  • Experience in Agri Project Management
  • Strong communication skills and composure when dealing with large scale projects and large teams
  • Process excellence mindset
  • People management. High cultural sensitivity and ability to motivate rural teams.
  • Ability to pre-empt issues and offer solutions to fire-fight
  • Willingness to travel to fields on daily basis
  • Ability to understand and engage with agrarian communities, understanding of farmers, FPOs, NGOs, Government Departments, etc...

Experience:

  • Strong professional experience (7+ years) - ideally in agri-project management, field extension management, input distribution/sales
  • Category experience in Paddy farming is strongly preferred
  • Proven experience in optimizing processes and building systems and strategies to support scale
  • Strong educational background, preferably in Agribusiness management, Field Extension management, operations / supply chain strategy type roles
  • Experience managing large field teams (100–300 people) through partner organizations or direct teams.
  • Demonstrated capability in building high-performance cultures, coaching mid-level managers, and creating accountability systems.
  • Strong ability to create MIS, and monitor KPIs at scale.
  • Hands-on experience using project management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, Excel, Looker Studio, etc.).
  • Experience in multi-district or multi-state program rollouts.
  • Prior experience implementing QA/QC frameworks, audits, field validation checks, and adherence to SOP.
  • Experience in generating detailed stakeholder-specific reports and documentation to synthesize findings and learnings to diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience ensuring compliance with carbon methodologies, government schemes, donor requirements, or agri certification programs.
  • Native fluency in Tamil is a must

Benefits

Purpose driven work - tackling the worlds most pressing challenges - climate change, food security, water security, farmer livelihoods improvement.

Culture / Team / Environment - our team includes the best minds in science, product, business and operations, in an environment where collaboration and openness is highly valued, unbiased, objective decision making, direct relationship with founders, and encouragement of career growth in a rapidly scaling organization.

Exposure to multiple stakeholders - internal and external, ability to operate at the center of the organization.

title: Director, Solution Engineering
description:
See what you can do with Prophix

Finance teams across 100+ countries use Prophix One™ to replace manual processes with intelligent planning, reporting, and automation. You will build, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Solution Engineers across Europe as well as work closely with your Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Professional Services counterparts in the region to ensure we are delivering on the vision we shaped with our prospects & customers. This is a role for someone who wants to make an impact at a company where the product is strong, the customer base is real, and the opportunity to leave a visible mark is significant. You'll have the backing of a PE-supported global business and the autonomy to shape how the EMEA pre-sales motion looks like for years to come.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Solution Engineers across EMEA, building an environment where continuous growth, accountability, and customer obsession are the norm. You'll recruit, coach, and retain talent that can meet finance leaders where they are and show them a better way forward.
  • Drive regional growth — your team's contribution to pipeline and closed revenue is the ultimate measure of success. You'll partner with Sales, Customer Sales & Channel Alliance leadership to ensure Solution Engineering effort is focused where it will have the greatest commercial impact.
  • Be a visible presence on strategic deals, joining your team in front of CFOs, Controllers, and senior finance leaders when the stakes are highest. Your credibility in the room — both technical and commercial — will shape how prospects experience Prophix at the moments that matter most.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Professional Services to ensure what we promise in the pre-sales cycle is grounded in what we can deliver — and that customer insights from the field flow back into how we build, position, and go to market.
  • Drive consistency and quality across how the team discovers, demonstrates, and proves value — building repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and assets that raise the ceiling for what EMEA Solution Engineering can deliver at scale.
  • Stay ahead of the market, tracking CPM/EPM trends, competitive movements, and evolving customer priorities across European markets — and feeding those insights back into product, sales strategy, and enablement.


What You Will Bring

We hire for potential as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t check every box, we still want to hear from you. At Prophix, people who ask good questions, adapt quickly, and bring a fresh perspective often make the biggest impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or presales consulting, including a minimum of 2 years directly managing or formally mentoring a presales team.
  • Proven track record building or scaling a presales function within a B2B SaaS environment, with experience in enterprise or mid-market software sales cycles.
  • Strong command of deal qualification and demo methodologies and best practices, with the ability to coach a team in applying them consistently and effectively.
  • Confident communicator and presenter across all levels of an organisation, from individual contributors through to senior business leaders and executive decision-makers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with full English proficiency (C2) required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Must have the right to work in the UK
  • Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to support tasks such as research, drafting, and data review
  • Able to learn new tools and adapt as technology and workflows evolve.
  • Curious, open to new approaches, and motivated to continuously improve.
  • Collaborative mindset when working across teams and with AI supported tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Academic or practical knowledge of financial concepts — including planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidations, and reporting — or prior experience in EPM/CPM, FP&A, or financial systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Financial Consolidation processes, Tax Reporting, ESG standards, or Regulatory Compliance frameworks such as XBRL or ESEF.
  • Proficiency in one or more additional European languages, enabling deeper engagement with prospects and customers across the region.
  • Familiarity with leading CPM or ERP platforms such as Prophix, Anaplan, Vena, Planful, or OneStream.
  • Experience working in a high-growth or scaling SaaS business, where building and evolving a function from the ground up was part of the role.

Benefits

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 days: You know our platform, our customers, and how your team operates. You’ve completed onboarding and are contributing to live work.
  • 90 days: You’re working independently, owning deliverables end to end, and building relationships across functions and regions.
  • 6 months: Your fingerprints are on something real. You’ve improved a process, shipped something meaningful, or earned a seat at the table on a decision that matters.

Why Join Prophix?

Joining Prophix in the UK means working as part of a genuinely global team with colleagues across Europe, North America, and Australia who bring different perspectives and work on shared problems. You’ll build breadth: cross functional experience, international exposure, and direct access to customers in a range of industries. We invest in learning and development, support flexible and hybrid working, and give people real ownership from day one. Our values are Pursue Excellence, Build with Purpose, Create Wins for All, and Drive Continuous Innovation. These shape how we work, not just what we say.


What’s Included for You?

  • Hybrid set-up from our Paddington office with flexible working hours
  • Private medical insurance through Vitality including mental health support and talking therapies
  • Income protection at 75% of earnings and death in service at 3x salary
  • NEST pension with 3% employer contribution
  • 25 days of annual leave, 10 sick days on full pay, 2 personal days, and 1 volunteer day
  • Total Wellness Benefit of £550/year
  • Professional development support and financial assistance for learning
  • Opportunities to participate in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives
  • Quarterly Town Halls and Kickoffs that bring teams together to celebrate wins, share updates, and look ahead at what’s next

Apply Now!

If you’re looking for a place where your work touches real products, real customers, and real decisions, and where your career can grow in the direction you choose. We would love to meet you. Apply and let’s talk about what’s possible.

Equal Opportunities & Inclusion

Prophix is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Accessibility & AI Transparency

Prophix promotes an accessible hiring process. If you need accommodation at any stage, we’ll work with you. Some interviews may be recorded so our hiring team can review and assess responses fairly and consistently. As part of our commitment to Responsible AI, we use a small number of AI-supported tools to help with tasks like resume review, shortlisting, or creating interview summaries. AI is never used as the sole basis for hiring decisions, and your personal data is never used to train AI models. If you'd prefer not to take part in any AI-assisted step, just let us know and we’ll be happy to accommodate.

Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you’ll be proud to tell your friends about.

We are looking for a Senior Security Analyst to detect, investigate, and respond to security events and incidents as part of our MSSP team. The main objective of this role is to support the team’s efforts and help our customers effectively manage and respond to security threats.

We look for people who embody:

Innovation to solve the hardest problems.

‍Accountability for every result.

‍Integrity always.

About The Role

  • Use analytical skills and attention to detail to monitor and respond to security events and incidents.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of team performance and operational efficiency.
  • Show eagerness to learn and proactively enhance skills in the cybersecurity field.
  • Monitor logs and security events across various security tools and act as the first responder to security incidents by performing triage, threat analysis, and containment.
  • Document and report on security incidents with detailed analysis and remediation recommendations, maintaining accurate records to enhance future responses.
  • Communicate incident response activities to stakeholders, including technical teams, senior management, and customers. Escalate complex issues to senior analysts as needed.
  • Optimize detection rules and alert thresholds to reduce false positives and improve accuracy.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify potential threats that bypass security controls and detection mechanisms.
  • Continuously research emerging threats and vulnerabilities to inform detection strategies and incident response playbooks.
  • Participate in our incident response on-call service to support the team when necessary

This role is designed for impact, and we believe our best work happens when we connect. While we operate a flexible model, we expect you to spend regular quality time on site (at our offices or a client location) for collaboration sessions, customer meetings, and internal workshops.

Requirements

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Understanding of how adversaries compromise networks, the stages of an attack, and effective detection techniques.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security technologies, operating systems, cloud services, and the ability to identify indicators of compromise across these environments.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in assessing security alerts, conducting log analysis, vulnerability assessments, and identifying exploitation techniques.
  • Self-driven with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in teams.
  • Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, and major cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with basic scripting and the ability to search log data and write detection rules using SQL-like query languages.

title: Territory Account Representative - Chicago, IL
description:
When you work at Trex, you’re helping to grow and enhance a true original. You join a company that boldly launched an entire industry… and still leads the way.

We are looking for an entry-level Territory Account Representative to help support sales and merchandising initiatives at Home Depot and Lowe’s stores within the territory. As a Trex Territory Account Representative, you will be looked to as an innovator in the manufacturing process and expected to meet sales goals by serving as the primary contact for retailers and increasing sales associates’ product knowledge. This role is ideal for someone just starting out or in the early stages of their sales career. This role is a key member of our Retail Sales team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Put safety first – Always!
  • Lead and foster our “people first” culture.
  • Serve as a primary contact for major home improvement retailers in their territory.
  • Regular and consistent in-store visits along with in-aisle execution and merchandising of Trex product
  • Offer product knowledge training for retail store associates, expand relationships, and increase sales.

JOB LOCATION

Chicago, IL

POSITION TYPE

Full-Time/Regular

EXPERIENCE

This is an entry-level outside sales position. We are looking for candidates with a proven track record of success through education, work experience, internships, or other relevant experience. Previous outside sales experience is preferred but not required.

At Trex, we believe in persevering even when there’s no road map, embracing groundbreaking as a way of life. We encourage multiple perspectives and welcome diverse people who problem-solve, adapt and innovate – always with a firm foundation in safety and integrity.

SALARY

This role has an annual salary of $57,500 with sales bonus eligibility.

The salary range provided serves as a general guideline for potential compensation for this position. It reflects the base salary and does not account for other benefits or additional compensation opportunities that may apply. This role is also eligible for further compensation through an annual/sales bonus in addition to the base salary.

At Trex, individual base salaries are determined based on various factors, including relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. We are committed to maintaining pay equity and consider the internal equity of our existing team members when finalizing compensation offers. In addition to competitive pay, Trex offers a comprehensive benefits package, which is detailed below.

WHO WE ARE

Over 30 years ago, our founders created the world’s first high-performance, low-maintenance composite decking and outdoor living products. That entrepreneurial spirit still drives us today as we continue to redefine our industry and lead the way for what’s next in outdoor living. Today, Trex is the world’s #1 brand of sustainability-made, wood-alternative decking, and deck railing – all proudly manufactured in the USA. As a publicly traded company [NYSE: TREX], we take pride in being the largest recycler of plastic film in the country as well as caring for the communities and the planet where we live. We nurture meaningful connections, from local engagement and investment to eco-friendly products and sustainable manufacturing processes.

Everything we do is grounded in our values and guided by our beliefs. We are looking for candidates who embody our core values:

  • Innovate with Purpose
  • Obsess Over the Customer
  • Own the Outcome
  • Operate with Excellence and Efficiency
  • Win Together

At Trex, you’ll become part of a diverse yet unified team that sustains the trailblazing spirit and strengths that made Trex the industry leader – learning, adapting, solving and succeeding.

We welcome new ideas and fresh perspectives, and we encourage you to bring your best to help us shape the future of Trex.

BENEFITS & PERKS

We believe that real effort should be rewarded. We take care of you as part of our Trex family so you can take care of yours. Here are some of the perks beyond the paycheck:

  • Time Off: We’ll give you paid holidays and paid vacation.
  • Health, Dental and Vision Insurance: Choose from a variety of options. We’ll cover a generous share of the cost. Plus, you can earn lower rates through our wellness program.
  • 401(k) With Company Match: Save for your retirement and we’ll match it dollar for dollar.
  • Tuition Reimbursement: We’re all about lifting each other to the next level. When you’re ready to get the degree, we’ll pick up part of the tab.
  • Training and Education: We offer dozens of options to boost your performance – both online and on-site nearby.
  • Stock Purchase Program: Invest in Trex at a discounted price.
  • Employee Discount Program: When you make the World’s No. 1 Decking Brand, you’ll probably want to enjoy the finished product yourself. We’ll give you a discount.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

At Trex, you can take pride in craftsmanship. There’s an art and a science to what we do, and we never stop working to refine and improve. That means no matter how long you’ve been with Trex, you have ongoing opportunities to grow your expertise – enhancing your career, your team and our shared efforts. You will help shape our future.

EOE

Trex is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these or any other characteristics protected by law

E-VERIFY

Trex participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. E-Verify is a web-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and the Social Security Administration (SSA) that allows employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their employees. For more information, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify.

As a Downline Line Machine Operator, the operator is responsible for running multiple machine systems and equipment in accordance with manufacturer specifications, company quality standards, SOPs, and applicable state and federal regulations. title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

Agility, Impact, Methodology. Do you exhibit these values and wish to be around others that do too? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where agility, adaptability, and high standards go hand in hand? Are you driven to make a meaningful impact, whether through your work, your support of others, or your commitment to your community? Are you motivated by a disciplined, science-based approach that ensures consistent excellence, safety, and integrity in everything you do? If these statements resonate with you, Grand River Aseptic Manufacturing (GRAM) welcomes you to apply to join our community of dedicated individuals improving lives every day!


Overview of this Position:

The Project Manager is responsible for leading technology transfer projects for new products being introduced into GRAM manufacturing facilities and/or manage ongoing Commercial Supply and Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects. Serves as the primary liaison between customers and cross-functional internal teams, oversees all phases of project execution from initiation through closure. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining project schedules, defining scope, tracking milestones, managing risks, assigning responsibilities and action items, monitoring critical path activities, and ensuring timely resolution or escalation of issues. Responsible for authoring project work orders/change orders, and other project documentation while maintaining accurate and up to date project data in SmartSheet. Strong organizational, communication, and relationship-management skills required.


This is a fully onsite position requiring flexibility to support customer visits and a dynamic project environment.


Non-Negotiable Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Biochemistry, or other Life Sciences or related field
  • 4 years related work experience in Pharma/Biotech/Life Sciences or similarly regulated industry.
  • Must have proficient computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, SharePoint, Outlook PowerPoint, and other relevant Project Management software (i.e. SmartSheet).
  • Experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory, or CMC regulatory environment.
  • Proficient in project management software required
  • Training or education in project management or equivalent knowledge and experience.
  • Regulatory knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing with GMPs, change control, risk management and quality by design.
  • Direct work experience in project management capacity, specifically with tech transfer of products into a sterile manufacturing facility.
  • Customer facing experience in pharmaceutical environment.

Preferred Requirements:

  • PMP Certification desired.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

  • Lead end-to-end project management for technology transfer, commercial supply, and lifecycle management (LCM) projects.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Define project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, risks, and success criteria.
  • Manage change controls, tech transfer plans, and project documentation.
  • Oversee execution of commercial supply agreements and ensure contractual commitments are met.
  • Coordinate resources and deliverables across multiple departments.
  • Facilitate project meetings, agendas, action items, and meeting minutes.
  • Drive risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and escalation.
  • Provide regular project updates to customers and senior leadership.
  • Identify, resolve and/or escalate issues in a timely fashion.
  • Build strong client relationships, manage expectations, and improve customer satisfaction.
  • Support customer visits and maintain flexibility in a dynamic environment.
  • Seek opportunities to increase client satisfaction and deepen relationships.
  • Assists with the professional development of the Project Managers and Associate Project Managers.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and make constructive suggestions for change.
Full job description available during formal interview process.

What Sets GRAM Apart from Other Employers:

BENEFITS starting day 1: Medical, prescription, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits are available to you and your family on your first day of work, with the company paying a portion of the cost! Once eligible for the 401(k) program, all your contributions are immediately 100% vested, and you are immediately vested in GRAM contributions as well. We also offer generous off-shift premiums!

Paid VOLUNTEERISM starting day 1: GRAM encourages giving back to our community by offering 16 hours of paid volunteer time per calendar year!

PAID TIME OFF: You choose how to use this time for your vacation, sick, or mental health needs! PTO: Full-time employees accrue up to 104 hours of paid time off per calendar year, with this amount being prorated your first year. WELLNESS TIME OFF (WTO): In addition to PTO, employees earn 1 hour of wellness time off for every 30 hours worked, to use how you choose.

PAID HOLIDAYS: We offer 10 paid holidays per calendar year with immediate eligibility!

PAY: Depends on Experience and is discussed during the interview process.


If you meet the required criteria listed above, GRAM welcomes you to apply today!

title: 3rd Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

As a Residential Support Specialist, you will provide a supportive and safe environment in community residential settings within MHA’s ICL (Integrated Community Living) department. This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

Pay Range: $19 - $21 an hour

Open Shift: Wednesday through Saturday 11pm-9am (40hrs)

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide respectful, person-centered support to participants in daily living activities, personal care, and skill development.
  • Promote community integration by facilitating access to transportation, social activities, and external resources.
  • Support participants' health needs, including medication administration (per MAP standards), appointment scheduling, and monitoring overall wellbeing.
  • Assist with financial skills and money management, maintaining accurate documentation of all expenditures.
  • Respond to emergencies and crisis situations appropriately, following agency protocols and communicating with supervisors.
  • Advocate for participants and help them build self-advocacy skills; serve as a liaison with families, providers, and community supports.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of Individual Service Plans (ISPs), documenting progress and participation.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including daily logs, incident reports, and health records.
  • Promote a safe environment by following all safety procedures, assisting with emergency drills, and identifying potential hazards.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members, attend training, maintain certifications (MAP, CPR, First Aid), and actively participate in meetings and supervision.

About Integration & Community Living (ICL)

The Integration & Community Living (ICL) program supports individuals with developmental disabilities and brain injuries in living independently and meaningfully in the community. In partnership with the Department of Developmental Services (DDS), ICL provides person-centered residential and outreach services across Western Massachusetts. With over 60 years of experience, MHA helps individuals transition from institutional settings into homes where they can grow, make choices, and fully participate in community life. Services range from supported and shared living to emergency respite and privately funded care, all designed to promote independence, dignity, and connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The Mental Health Association is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and computer skills.
  • Adaptability to participants' changing needs.
  • Provide personal care, including assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.
  • Ability to pass and maintain certifications in medication administration (MAP), CPR, and First Aid.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • High school diploma or GED required; college degree in human services or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of six months of relevant experience; experience with individuals with brain injuries, mental health challenges, or developmental disabilities is preferred.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (403B, IRA)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Long Term Disability
  • $19-21 an hour

title: Technical Illustrator
description:
Sportech is a rapidly growing company in Elk River, MN. We are looking for talented people who wish to join a values-based company that desires to help our people and customers win. We design, manufacture, and assemble cab components and systems for the powersports, golf and turf, industrial and agricultural end markets. Our design and engineering capabilities allow us to provide complex components and assemblies to our original equipment manufacturer customers. We are always on the gas and seeking dynamic, enthusiastic, and motivated individuals to join our extraordinary team.


Sportech offers eligible full-time employees a robust and competitive benefits package, which includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options, including flexible spending accounts (HSA, FSA, and DCA)
  • Short-term and long-term disability benefits
  • Basic life insurance and voluntary life insurance
  • Hospital indemnity plans, pet insurance, and legal/identity theft services
  • 401k plan with up to a 4% employer match
  • Paid company holidays, paid vacation, and paid volunteer time
  • Sportech Learning Academy (SLA) with courses offered onsite quarterly, focusing on personal and professional growth and development for employees, and tuition reimbursement options for courses completed outside of Sportech

Further benefits information is provided as part of the offer process for any offer extended by Sportech. Pay varies by position and is based on multiple factors including labor market data and, depending on position, may include education, work experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, and/or certifications. Additionally, Sportech takes into account the internal equity of current employees when considering compensation. Sportech’s reasonable and good-faith estimate for new hire compensation at the time of posting for this position is $27.00 - $31.00 per hour. Pay may also include variable compensation from time to time such as overtime for non-exempt positions, shift differential for specific shifts, and/or bonus targets (subject to plan eligibility and other requirements).


Job Summary

This position will design, develop, and write technical documentation for Sportech products in accordance with corporate and engineering standards. The Technical Illustrator will create, update, and modify work instructions for production processes and other technical communication needs throughout Sportech as required. Work Instructions provide Team Members concise and clear information to perform their job functions and procedures accurately and safely. Additional documentation will include equipment manuals, product support materials (i.e., product installation instructions), and internal help documents.


Essential Job Functions

  • Continuously drives the creation and improvement of Work Instructions.
  • Reviews Work Instruction documentation, revisions, and edits as required.
  • Reviews Work Instructions with Team Members through audience analysis and evaluation to ensure work instruction accuracy.
  • Write and update product installation instructions, various supporting process instructions, and related documents.
  • Complete Redlines and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) affecting technical publication documents.
  • Follow set standards regarding format, content, order, clarity, conciseness, style, and terminology.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, legal representatives, safety experts, and fellow technical illustrators to develop clear, accurate documents.
  • Maintain records and files of work and revisions.
  • Support both digital and legacy print work instructions and documentation.

Wilson Butler Architects is an innovative and collaborative design studio specializing in arts and entertainment experiences. The firm’s open studio environment encourages a fun and creative process. We are located in Boston’s Financial District overlooking Post Office Square.

The exciting news: we are growing and looking for an Interior Designer to join our spirited team!

Similar to Architects, Interiors Designers at Wilson Butler Architects are global thinkers with the skillset to thoroughly work out the details behind their ideas. They possess the ability to establish an overall design vision for a project, successfully translate it for clients and see it through to completion; the ability to visualize 3D spaces, and to understand scale and proportion. It is essential that Interior Designers have an understanding of how things are built (millwork/casework, stairs, railings, etc) and be able and willing to help with the development of architectural details. Interior Designers are a resource of knowledge on materials, products and furniture for every design team at the firm.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires excellent organization with a skill for prioritizing demands for more than one project at a time, while completing work with consistent accuracy.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Planning and designing interior environments
  • Researching images, precedents and inspiration, and developing design concepts

  • Rendering of elevations and plans, including furniture & floor finish layouts
  • Helping maintain Interior materials library
  • Provide space planning layouts and ideas

Requirements

The ideal applicant has the following attributes:

  • A professional degree in Interior Design or related field
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in the fields of commercial and/or hospitality design
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills
  • Scrupulous attention to detail
  • Revit experience and skills are paramount

  • Ability to balance the needs of 2 to 3 projects at a time

Benefits

We want to see you grow and succeed!

We encourage our staff to develop their skills and offer meaningful contributions to the firm. Our size allows for each team member to try their hand at every aspect of the design process. However, this is a product of more than our size, it emanates from the attitude and culture of our Directors and Principals. Our leadership actively engages the staff in all aspects of the design process as well as the business. We encourage our employees, when their skills and ambition dictate, to lead client meetings, assisting with business development needs and open new project sectors. Your ideas and voice will be heard.

Salary commensurate with experience. The compensation range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

We offer many benefits including health, dental, and a competitive 401k plan, bonus opportunities, professional development and licensure support, holiday, vacation, and sick time. Wilson Butler Architects Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes diversity in the workplace. EOE M/F/H/V.

title: Product Management Intern (2027 Summer Internship)
description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: .

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

At AppLovin, we believe the future of social platforms isn't just about entertainment — it's about meaningful value exchange. We are building a next-generation global content platform that empowers people to turn real-life experiences into inspiring, useful stories that help others grow. This isn't another short-form video app. It's a platform where authentic sharing matters, where people from diverse backgrounds and life stages can contribute, find content they actually need, and be rewarded for the value they create.
Backed by AppLovin's world-class technology, data capabilities, and global reach, we are a small, high-caliber founding team building this from the ground up — and we're looking for a Product Manager Intern for Summer 2027 who wants to be part of it from the earliest days.

About the Team
Our product team sits at the intersection of user behaviour, content ecosystems, and data. We debate ideas rigorously, take ownership seriously, and move with startup speed. As a PM intern, you won't be running meeting notes or maintaining backlogs. You'll be embedded in a real product area — user growth, content contribution, discovery, or creator incentives — working alongside PMs, engineers, and designers on problems that directly shape the platform's trajectory.

About Gist
Gist is a new social media platform for people who want substance — practical, thoughtful content that spans philosophy debates, city-specific recommendations, seasonal gift guides, and wellness tips. Across categories like travel, food, career, and family, we describe it as "a handbook for the curious."
Gist is built by AppLovin Corporation — a company that hit $5.3B in revenue last year and sits alongside Google and Meta as one of the world's leading ad tech platforms. Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021–2024).

What You'll Do

  • Own a focused internship project within a defined product area — from problem framing and user research through to spec, execution, and measurement.
  • Conduct user research and synthesise behavioural insights to surface clear, actionable product opportunities.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to define requirements, align on trade-offs, and ship features iteratively.
  • Analyse product metrics and experiment results to form a point of view on what's working and what isn't.
  • Contribute to discussions on content growth, contributor incentives, or discovery — with your own perspective, not just support work.


Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree or above in any field — Computer Science, Business, Cognitive Science, Economics, and related disciplines are all welcome.
  • Strong user empathy and genuine curiosity about why people share content, what makes it valuable, and how platforms shape behaviour.
  • Comfortable working with data — you can form a hypothesis, look at numbers critically, and update your thinking based on what you find.
  • Clear communicator who can articulate a problem, a trade-off, or a recommendation to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excited about building in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the product is still being defined.


Good To Have

  • Any prior experience in product, strategy, growth, UX research, or data analysis — internships, coursework projects, or student org work all count.
  • Familiarity with product tools such as Figma, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or SQL.
  • Personal interest in content platforms, creator ecosystems, community products, or social apps — and a considered opinion on what makes them work or fail.
  • Exposure to experimentation concepts (A/B testing, metric frameworks, funnel analysis).
AppLovin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or other legally protected characteristics. title: Clinician- Criminal Justice Specialist
description:
Clinician- Criminal Justice Specialist

The Clinician – Criminal Justice Specialist is a clinical member of the evidence-based Forensic Assertive Community Treatment Team (FACT) serving Albany and Schenectady Counites and is responsible for providing integrated, community-based treatment and support services to adults with serious mental illness, co-occurring substance use disorders, chronic health conditions, social needs, and involvement with the criminal justice system. The Criminal Justice Specialist serves as the team’s primary resource for criminal justice-related assessment, intervention, and coordination. Duties include:

· Conduct comprehensive assessments using person-centered, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-oriented approaches. Identify individual strengths, needs, barriers, risks, and goals and incorporate findings into individualized treatment and service planning.

· Provide comprehensive, meaningful, and purposeful clinical and support services in the office and community, including individuals’ homes, apartments, shelters, hospitals, correctional facilities, courts, and other community settings as appropriate.

· Provide and/or coordinate clinical services, crisis intervention, medication support and supervision, case management, advocacy, skill development, referrals, and linkage to community resources in accordance with the individual’s treatment plan.

· Assess individual clinical, behavioral health, social, housing, employment, substance use, and other identified needs and collaborate with individuals to develop strategies that promote community stability and reduce the likelihood of justice-system involvement.

· Respond to crisis situations and urgent needs to promote the safety and well-being of individuals served, staff, and the community. Participate in the FACT Team’s rotating on-call responsibilities and provide crisis intervention, assessment, support, and linkage to appropriate emergency or community-based services when necessary.

· Participate in community meetings, case conferences, court-related meetings, treatment court meetings, and other meetings as assigned to support continuity of care and positive treatment outcomes.

· Serve as the primary clinical resource regarding criminal justice involvement and coordinate services across the continuum of justice-system contact, including pre-arrest and pretrial involvement through probation, parole, treatment court, incarceration/re-entry, and other applicable justice-system requirements.

· Conduct standardized criminogenic risk and needs assessments to identify criminogenic risks and needs and guide individualized interventions designed to reduce risk, promote behavioral change, and decrease recidivism.

· Take a lead role in integrating criminogenic assessment findings into individualized treatment and service plans, ensuring interventions address identified risks and needs while remaining responsive to the individual’s strengths, abilities, culture, preferences, and stage of recovery.

· Collaborate with individuals to identify practical strategies for reducing behaviors and circumstances that may contribute to arrest, incarceration, community disruption, or re-offending.

· Assist individuals in understanding and navigating applicable criminal justice processes and requirements and support successful engagement with probation, parole, treatment courts, courts, attorneys, correctional facilities, and other justice-system partners.

· Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with community stakeholders, including criminal justice agencies, probation and parole, courts, treatment courts, housing providers, behavioral health, and substance use treatment providers, hospitals, hospitals-based providers, local governmental units, and other community partners.

· Provide transportation to individuals when clinically or programmatically necessary, utilizing agency vehicles. Maintain access to a reliable personal vehicle and be willing to use the vehicle for community meetings when not transporting an individual.

· Mohawk Opportunities programs and offices may include multiple levels accessible only by stairs. Community-based services may require visits to individuals’ apartments and residences, including locations on upper floors.

Requirements

Skills/Qualifications for the Clinician- Criminal Justice Specialist include:

  • New York State licensure as a LMSW, LCSW, LMHC, or other applicable credentials appropriate to the position.
  • Minimum of three years of experience providing services to individuals with serious mental illness, co-occurring disorders, or other complex behavioral health needs required.
  • Minimum of one year of experience working with individuals involved in the criminal justice system, including experience with probation, parole, treatment courts, courts, correctional settings, re-entry, or other justice-system processes required.
  • Experience working within an ACT, FACT, intensive community-based behavioral health, forensic mental health, criminal justice, or similarly integrated service model preferred.
  • Strong commitment to the rights, dignity, autonomy, and self-determination of individuals with mental illness, including their ability to make informed choices, live successfully in the community, pursue employment and meaningful activities, and access ongoing support and services that promote wellness and recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team while also exercising independent clinical judgment and managing responsibilities in a flexible, field-based environment.
  • Bilingual or multilingual abilities are a plus.
  • Valid and insurable New York State driver’s license and ability to meet agency requirements for approved drivers.
  • Access to a reliable personal vehicle and willingness to use the vehicle for authorized business purposes.

Benefits

Salary and Benefits of the Clinician- Criminal Justice Specialist

• $2,852.00/biweekly; $74,152.00/annual equivalent. 40 hours per week

• On-call on a rotation basis. $210/week on-call stipend.

• Excellent benefits, staff training, generous paid time off, and a 30-minute paid lunch.

• Supportive work environment.

title: Microbiological Lab Analyst
description:
Founded in 1969, Pharmathen has grown into a leading developer and manufacturer of specialized pharmaceutical products and one of the largest vertically integrated companies in advanced drug delivery technologies. With a strong international presence, we remain committed to improving people’s lives through innovation and access to affordable, high-quality medicines. Today, our products reach patients in more than 90 countries worldwide, supporting better health outcomes every day.

Pharmathen employs more than 1,600 people from over 27 different nationalities, reflecting a diverse and international workforce. Our achievements are driven by strong scientific expertise, high ethical standards, and the dedication of our people, who share a commitment to improving patient lives.

These include routine and non-routine microbiological tests on in-process and final container products, as well as environmental monitoring samples. title: 1st & 2nd Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

As a Residential Support Specialist, you will provide a supportive and safe environment in community residential settings within MHA’s ICL (Integrated Community Living) department. This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

Pay Range: $19 - $21 an hour

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide respectful, person-centered support to participants in daily living activities, personal care, and skill development.
  • Promote community integration by facilitating access to transportation, social activities, and external resources.
  • Support participants' health needs, including medication administration (per MAP standards), appointment scheduling, and monitoring overall wellbeing.
  • Assist with financial skills and money management, maintaining accurate documentation of all expenditures.
  • Respond to emergencies and crisis situations appropriately, following agency protocols and communicating with supervisors.

About Integration & Community Living (ICL)

The Integration & Community Living (ICL) program supports individuals with developmental disabilities and brain injuries in living independently and meaningfully in the community. In partnership with the Department of Developmental Services (DDS), ICL provides person-centered residential and outreach services across Western Massachusetts. With over 60 years of experience, MHA helps individuals transition from institutional settings into homes where they can grow, make choices, and fully participate in community life. Services range from supported and shared living to emergency respite and privately funded care, all designed to promote independence, dignity, and connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The Mental Health Association is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.

title: Environmental Scientist, Project Manager
description:
Working as an Environmental Scientist, Project Manager in the Brownfield & Assessment Service Group providing environmental site assessment (ESA), remediation and re-development services for clients throughout Canada. This position focuses on the execution of excellent project management services and contributes to the mentorship and development of junior staff. The incumbent will build on MEMS experienced and technically strong teams to successfully execute low complexity to moderately complex work plans. This incumbent can manage multiple work scopes or projects in alignment with MEMS’ overall corporate strategy. This position is full time and requires a combination of office and fieldwork. Expectations for field work in this role to be primarily for complex Sites and/or in a mentorship role.

Please note that this position could be based out of any of our Western Canada (BC, AB, SK) offices.

Key Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities of this position are identified below, but other duties may evolve as required.

Client Project Management

  • Manage projects of low to medium complexity including sub-consultants and regulatory requirements in accordance with MEMS project management requirements;
  • Apply appropriate project management techniques to execute all aspects of the project in accordance with the contract and ensuring quality of processes and deliverables; and
  • Mentorship, supervision and promotion of career development of direct reports.

Technical Engagement

  • Synthesize published and site specific information to present a concise interpretation of the site conditions and develop a conceptual site model to assist in understanding and communicating key site issues;
  • Conducting site specific risk assessments and developing risk-based remedial objectives for contaminated sites of medium to high complexity with low to moderate senior input required.
  • Primary authorship role in completion of risk assessment projects for complex sites;
  • Primary development of appropriate risk-based site management strategies with limited input from senior risk assessment staff; and
  • Progression to a reviewer role of project deliverables for low to moderately complex Sites.

Mentorship

  • Identify competency gaps within the service group and communicate these effectively to the Service Group Director;
  • Contribute to the execution of mentorship and competency training programs; and
  • Provide direct mentorship of staff.

Field Work Execution

  • In a primarily mentorship role for purposes of junior staff career development on moderately complex Sites, acting as a mentorship lead in the planning, organization and execution or oversight of field programs with a focus on sites requiring risk-based solutions.
  • Working with contractors to implement ESA and remediation projects on complex Sites in consultation with MEMS senior project management staff and/or MEMS Executive.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

  • 4-6 years experience in environmental site assessment and remediation, preferably in a consulting environment.
  • Eligibility for membership in a relevant professional organization is required,
  • Must be able to meet the requirements of site access as dictated by our clients, this may include pre-access drug, alcohol and fitness testing, and
  • possess a valid, non-GDL Class 5 Drivers license.

Other Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledge and experience with current provincial and federal legislation and familiarity with the environmental site assessment process.
  • Understanding of the Alberta Tier 1 and Tier 2 guideline documents and/or equivalent documents from other jurisdictions as required.
  • Understanding of the upstream and downstream oil & gas industry, oil sands industry and commercial/industrial/brownfields environmental industry.
  • Strong computer skills with knowledge of MS Office Suite.
  • Be able to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary setting.
  • Ability to work either independently or as a part of a team interacting with other team members and contractors.
  • Able to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic; and
  • Excellent safety attitude.

Working Conditions:

  • This individual should expect to spend approximately 20% of their work time at client sites; each individual trip lasting anywhere from 1 to 12 days. This individual may conduct assessments at industrial facilities and or greenfield sites in remote locations. In some cases, the field work may include carrying sampling equipment;
  • office environment that requires sitting for extended periods of time, as well as field work;
  • prolonged exposure to computer keyboards and computer screens;
  • manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals;
  • sometimes requires long hours of work. Occasional interruptions outside work hours and travel to other locations are required;
  • ability to work varying shifts, including the occasional evening and night; and
  • required to walk, stand, climb, bend forward, kneel down, crawl, reach and grasp, push and pull objects, lift and/or move up to 30 kg, sometimes over the shoulders, repetitive bending and lifting of items, along with repetitive arm movements.
