title: QC Supervisor
description:
Voor ons Quality team in Amersfoort zijn wij op zoek naar een Supervisor Quality Control. In deze rol combineer je vakinhoudelijke QC-kennis met leiderschap en kwaliteitsborging. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het waarborgen én continu verbeteren van de kwaliteit van onze processen en producten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Supervisor Quality Control ben je verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en correct uitvoeren van analyses op verkregen monsters. De resultaten hiervan zijn essentieel voor het proces en voor het borgen van productkwaliteit en compliance.

Daarnaast geef je leiding aan het QC-laboratoriumteam (circa 4 FTE) en ben je verantwoordelijk voor planning, procedures en budget.

! Jouw werklocatie - Je uiteindelijke standplaats is ons laboratorium in Zaandam. Omdat ons laboratorium in Zaandam wordt gerenoveerd, zal je in eerste instantie werkzaam zijn vanuit ons R&D-lab in Amersfoort. We verwachten dat deze tijdelijke situatie ongeveer twee jaar zal duren. Zodra de renovatie is afgerond, verhuis je samen met het team terug naar Zaandam.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Controleren en valideren van resultaten uit standaard- en specifieke analyses.
  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor complexere vraagstukken binnen het laboratorium.
  • Leidinggeven aan en coachen van de analisten op het lab; je stimuleert ontwikkeling en samenwerking.
  • Opstellen en beheren van de personeelsplanning voor dagdienst en overige diensten, met oog voor een optimale bezetting.
  • Beheren en verbeteren van het kwaliteitssysteem door middel van o.a. CAPA’s, risk assessments en trainingen.
  • Zorgdragen dat het laboratorium voldoet aan geldende wet- en regelgeving en richtlijnen, waaronder ISO 22001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, Kosher, Halal en Kiwa.
  • Leiden van interne audits binnen het QC-laboratorium en uitvoeren van externe audits bij leveranciers en externe partijen.
  • Verantwoordelijk voor procedures, werkinstructies en het QC-budget.

Requirements

Je bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die verantwoordelijkheid neemt en mensen weet mee te nemen. Je zet de toon op kwaliteit, veiligheid en samenwerking.

Wij zoeken iemand met:

  • Een afgeronde HLO-opleiding (of vergelijkbaar).
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare QC-functie.
  • Minimaal 3 jaar leidinggevende ervaring.
  • Een proactieve houding en het principe “leading by example” hoog in het vaandel en probleemoplossend vermogen.
  • Het vermogen om met mensen te werken en de lat elke dag een beetje hoger te leggen.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Benefits

  • Een uitdagende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en invloed.
  • Een prettige werksfeer waarin collega’s elkaar helpen en ondersteunen.
  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen, waar eigenaarschap en initiatief worden gewaardeerd.
  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor ontwikkeling, onder andere via on-the-job learning, trainingen en cursussen.
  • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar en 14 ADV.
  • Een jaarsalaris tussen EUR 63000 en EUR 75000 op basis van opleiding en ervaring, inclusief 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld en op basis van 36 uur per week.
  • Een jaarcontract met de intentie tot dienstverband.

Experienced Delivery Manager with a proven track record of leading Agile teams, delivering complex change initiatives, and driving successful outcomes through strong stakeholder engagement, delivery leadership and continuous improvement.

Following a screen with the Recruitment Team you can expect a two-stage interview process, one online and one in-person.

Have you made it this far?

Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented people might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself.

title: 2nd Shift Direct Care
description:

This role involves traveling to different program locations based on staffing needs, offering flexibility and consistent support across the department. You will help foster growth, independence, and community engagement for individuals who have experienced a brain injury resulting in physical limitations, mental health, and/or cognitive challenges.

﻿

﻿

Services range from supported and shared living to emergency respite and privately funded care, all designed to promote independence, dignity, and connection.

﻿

title: Quality and Reliability Engineer
description:
Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress.

If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.

About Custom Mechanical Solutions

Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support.

As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization.

Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer
Department: CMS National Accounts
Location: Fully remote within the United States
Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel

Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes.

Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales.

The opportunity

CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects.

Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions.

What you will own

  • Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure.
  • Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation.
  • Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence.
  • Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed.
  • Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners.
  • Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness.

You will probably love this role if...

  • When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer.
  • You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly.
  • You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed.
  • You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved.
  • You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one.

Required qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support.
  • Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills.
  • Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico.
  • A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience.
  • Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes.
  • Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations.
  • Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards.
  • Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience.
  • This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus.
  • Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms.

Why CMS National Accounts

You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio.

If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you.

Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship.

Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location.

title: Experienced Recruitment Consultant - Information Security - Contract Desk
description:
At La Fosse, we’re an employee-owned talent solutions business specialising in tech, digital, and change, but people are always at the heart of what we do.

Our mission is to create a working world where talent is recognised for its value, not its background. We help businesses of all sizes solve people and growth challenges through recruitment, our academy, solutions, and executive search.

What makes us different? Everyone here has a stake in the business. Being employee-owned means we all have a voice, and we all share in our success – quite literally. Through our employee ownership model, everyone benefits financially from the value we create together, with profit-sharing and long-term wealth-building opportunities built in.

We’re ambitious, collaborative, and care about doing great work with great people. There’s real focus on learning, development, and building meaningful careers, in a culture that’s grounded, inclusive, and fun.

If you’re after purpose, progression, and the chance to shape something exciting, La Fosse is the place to do it.

The Role:

We’re looking for an Experienced Consultant to join our Technology and Operations division and join one of our most profitable teams - Information Security. This is a 360 contract recruitment role where you’ll be working with both existing clients across the La Fosse network and developing new business opportunities. You’ll partner closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver high-impact talent solutions, while also building strong relationships with top-tier tech professionals across Europe.

If you’re commercially driven, passionate about tech recruitment, and ready to make an impact in a high-performing, collaborative team, this could be the perfect next step.

The Team:

You’ll be joining a team of 14 who are one of our highest performing teams in the business, the top biller in this division achieved over £1.1m in 2024. So far in 2025, the Security team have been consistently billing over £120k a month per head and hit 140% of their budget for H1, showcasing both their performance and the size of the opportunity for growth.

Hear from some of our team HERE about what they love about working at La Fosse.

What will you be doing?

  • Client Partnership: Build and maintain strong client relationships, offering market insight, salary benchmarking, and talent strategy advice.
  • Business Development: Identify and win new business through networking, referrals, and proactive outreach.
  • Candidate Attraction: Source and engage high-quality candidates using platforms like LinkedIn, job boards, and your own network.
  • Recruitment Delivery: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from job brief to offer, ensuring a smooth, professional experience for both clients and candidates.
  • Offer & Negotiation: Support clients and candidates from negotiating terms through to managing best package for candidates at offer stage.
  • Compliance & CRM: Keep accurate records in Bullhorn and ensure alignment with GDPR, employment law, and internal standards.
  • Market Expertise: Stay ahead of industry trends and share insights to support clients’ needs.
  • Team Collaboration: Live our values of care, ambition, and humility, contributing to a high-performing, inclusive team culture.

Requirements

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Proven experience in a 360 recruitment role, ideally within the tech, digital, or change space.
  • A strong track record of business development and client relationship management.
  • Confidence sourcing talent through platforms like LinkedIn, job boards, and your own network.
  • The ability to manage the full recruitment lifecycle with professionalism and attention to detail.
  • Solid negotiation and offer management skills, with a commercial mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to influence and build trust.
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset, with a proactive approach to hitting personal and shared targets.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple roles and stakeholders at once.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (Bullhorn experience is a plus) and an understanding of recruitment compliance and best practices.

What are the Standards & Expectations we live by?

  • We support each other to be as successful as we can.
  • Treat others how you would like to be treated.
  • We put our teams before ourselves.
  • We think and act on what is best for the overall business.

Benefits

What can you earn?

When you join our recruitment team, you will start on a flat commission structure with no threshold to help you settle in, then move you to our standard structure where you will earn 33% of any NFI up to £800k and 40% on billings beyond that, ensuring a clear and rewarding commission structure. You can also earn through additional earning streams such as Management overrides, cross-selling and referral bonuses from our Academy & Solutions service lines. Please use this LINK to look at commission figures.

Benefits:

💸 Industry-Leading Commission Structure: Earn from day one with our competitive commission scheme.

🌴 Annual Leave: Enjoy up to 30 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a Christmas closure period.

🏙️ Hybrid Working Model: We work 3-4 days a week from our London office, with 2 weeks per year to work from anywhere, whether that’s by the beach, in the countryside, or closer to family.

🎿 Annual Company Ski Trip: Hit the slopes with the team, our all-company ski trip is open to everyone.

💆 Wellness Perks: We subsidise your gym membership to help you stay active and energised, and offer weekly in-office massages for a midweek recharge.

🧠 Mental Health Support: Access to professional support and resources to help you prioritise your wellbeing.

👶 Enhanced Maternity Pay: We provide enhanced maternity packages to support you through life’s important milestones.

🎉 Incentives & Socials: Regular team socials, performance incentives, and rewards to celebrate your success.

🦷 Private Health & Dental Discounts: Take advantage of discounted private healthcare and dental plans, because your health matters.

The Interview Process:

We want to make sure this role is the perfect fit for both you and us. Here’s what to expect:

  • Call with our TA team: To learn more about you and to tell you more about us!
  • 1st Stage Teams Interview: A commercial-focused conversation with the hiring manager or team lead.
  • Psychometric Assessment: A short online assessment to help us understand your working style, preferences, and strengths.
  • Final Stage Interview - in person: An opportunity to meet the team, learn more about La Fosse and dig into what your first 6 months could look like.

At La Fosse, we believe diverse teams create better outcomes. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. If this role excites you but you don’t tick every box, we still encourage you to apply!

🔗 Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and let’s grow together.

title: Internal Process Auditor (Remote)
description:
About the Role

KAIZEN is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Internal Process Auditor to ensure robust internal compliance across services such as PPMs (Planned Preventive Maintenance), AMCs (Annual Maintenance Contracts), and Building Insurances. The ideal candidate will champion ISO 9001:2015 standards, lead internal audits, manage risk, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Internal Audit Coordination:
    Plan, schedule, and execute ISO 9001:2015 internal audits.
  • Compliance Monitoring:
    Ensure ongoing compliance of AMCs, PPMs, and insurances with local regulations and internal standards.
  • Documentation & QMS Management:
    Maintain, update, and improve QMS documentation and SOPs.
  • Risk & Non-Conformity Management:
    Identify, escalate, and resolve risks and non-conformities through effective root cause analysis.
  • Reporting & Presentation:
    Prepare and present monthly audit reports, findings, and recommendations to management.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    Recommend improvements, follow up on corrective actions, and measure impact.
  • ISO Engagement & Training:
    Stay updated on ISO standards and deliver awareness sessions across teams.
  • Cost Management:
    Conduct cost analysis, assist with budgeting, and lead negotiations for improved service efficiency.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in internal auditing or quality management
  • ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor certification
  • Experience in facilities management, AMC/PPM operations, or insurance compliance

Key Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Critical thinking and risk management
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities
  • Independence and self-motivation
  • Familiarity with continuous improvement practices
  • Proficiency with tools like Excel, Audit Schedulers, QMS, Risk Registers

title: QC Chemist I
description:
QC Chemist I

Agility, Impact, Methodology. Do you exhibit these values and wish to be around others that do too? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where agility, adaptability, and high standards go hand in hand? Are you driven to make a meaningful impact, whether through your work, your support of others, or your commitment to your community? Are you motivated by a disciplined, science-based approach that ensures consistent excellence, safety, and integrity in everything you do? If these statements resonate with you, Grand River Aseptic Manufacturing (GRAM) welcomes you to apply to join our community of dedicated individuals improving lives every day!


Overview of this Position:

The QC Chemist I supports quality systems as they relate to the manufacturing and testing of cGMP drug products. These duties include, but are not limited to, providing general laboratory support for raw materials and excipient testing used in the finished product.


Non-Negotiable Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry and/or other related discipline (e.g. Biochemistry, Biotechnology).
  • Minimum of 1-3 years pharmaceutical or testing experience.
  • Qualification for use of a full-face respirator is required.
  • Proficient computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Excellent written and verbal skills; Ability to communicate effectively with management, staff, and regulatory agencies by exhibiting excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

  • Perform physical, chemical, and instrumental analysis of active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients and finished pharmaceutical products and excipients.
  • Prepare standards and samples for analysis.
  • Run instrumentation independently including, but not limited to, HPLC, FTIR, UV VIS, and physical testing on pharmaceutical products according to client/compendia procedures and departmental SOPs.
  • Review laboratory data for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to GMP and/or GLP regulations.
  • Process data, generate reports, and evaluate data.
  • Perform all job responsibilities in compliance with cGMPs, company SOP’s, and current industry practice.
Full job description available during formal interview process.


What Sets GRAM Apart from Other Employers:

BENEFITS starting day 1: Medical, prescription, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits are available to you and your family on your first day of work, with the company paying a portion of the cost! Once eligible for the 401(k) program, all your contributions are immediately 100% vested, and you are immediately vested in GRAM contributions as well. We also offer generous off-shift premiums!

Paid VOLUNTEERISM starting day 1: GRAM encourages giving back to our community by offering 16 hours of paid volunteer time per calendar year!

PAID TIME OFF: You choose how to use this time for your vacation, sick, or mental health needs! PTO: Full-time employees accrue up to 104 hours of paid time off per calendar year, with this amount being prorated your first year. WELLNESS TIME OFF (WTO): In addition to PTO, employees earn 1 hour of wellness time off for every 30 hours worked, to use how you choose.

PAID HOLIDAYS: We offer 10 paid holidays per calendar year with immediate eligibility!

PAY: Depends on Experience and is discussed during the interview process.


If you meet the required criteria listed above, GRAM welcomes you to apply today!

title: Head of Supply Chain
description:
Agility, Impact, Methodology. Do you exhibit these values and wish to be around others that do too? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where agility, adaptability, and high standards go hand in hand? Are you driven to make a meaningful impact, whether through your work, your support of others, or your commitment to your community? Are you motivated by a disciplined, science-based approach that ensures consistent excellence, safety, and integrity in everything you do? If these statements resonate with you, Grand River Aseptic Manufacturing (GRAM) welcomes you to apply to join our community of dedicated individuals improving lives every day!


Overview of this Position:

The Head of Supply Chain will design, execute, and scale the end-to-end global supply chain strategy across the enterprise. This high-impact executive role owns the integration of material management, procurement, warehousing, and multi-site logistics. Crucially, this position carries full accountability for establishing, executing, and evolving GRAM’s Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) framework, harmonizing client demand forecasts while challenging capacity constraints. Additionally, this position is responsible for all Client Service, Master Data, Procurement and Inventory Control functions. Furthermore, this role must establish goals and objectives, supervise work practices for direct reports, interpret and execute policies and procedures that typically affect organizational units. At the senior level, this position requires extensive independent judgment, ability to interact with senior leadership, plan and execute site strategy aligned to GRAM’s vison and objectives.


Non-Negotiable Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field with over 10 years’ experience providing strategic and operational leadership in a customer driven planning and logistics environment.
  • Prior experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry (CDMO preferred) experience is needed, with SLT responsibility.
  • Managing Supply Chain in an ERP environment, system implementation experience is needed.
  • As the interface with the client and Operations Team, actively contribute to the development and implementation of logistics and planning strategy.
  • Must have proficient computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

Preferred Requirements

  • Master’s degree in a related field.

Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

  • Establish and lead a mature, monthly multi-site S&OP process that balances client commercial/clinical forecasts with manufacturing reality across multi-site facilities.
  • Facilitate Executive S&OP meetings, translating raw data into actionable decision matrices for capacity expansions, capital expenditure (CapEx), labor planning, and inventory optimization.
  • Develop cross-facility capacity modeling to dynamically adjust scheduling based on machine down-times, line validations, client delays, or regulatory holds.
  • Optimize local logistics and tracking mechanisms for intermediate materials, raw ingredients, and single-use assemblies moving between the 5 co-located manufacturing and warehousing sites.
  • Manage Commercial supply agreements, ensure highest level of service levels and timely batch release.
  • Intervene and resolve current / upcoming servicing issues through strong cross functional processes.
  • Implement and manage the planning and release function to ensure optimal processing of client orders.
  • Work closely with operations and quality to develop production/laboratory capacity plans and strategies for the medium and long term.
  • Negotiate and manage supply agreements and co-ordinate Supply Chain related items with clients.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of logistics and planning strategy by interfacing with the client and operations Teams.

Full job description available during formal interview process.


What Sets GRAM Apart from Other Employers:

BENEFITS starting day 1: Medical, prescription, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits are available to you and your family on your first day of work, with the company paying a portion of the cost! Once eligible for the 401(k) program, all your contributions are immediately 100% vested, and you are immediately vested in GRAM contributions as well. We also offer generous off-shift premiums!

Paid VOLUNTEERISM starting day 1: GRAM encourages giving back to our community by offering 16 hours of paid volunteer time per calendar year!

PTO: Full-time employees accrue up to 13 days of time off per calendar year. You choose how to use this time for your vacation, sick, or mental health needs!

WELLNESS TIME OFF: Employees earn 1 hour of time off for every 30 hours worked to use how you choose.

title: Manufacturing Shift Team Leader LAI (Rodopi)
location: Sapes, East Macedonia and Thrace, Greece
description:
Founded in 1969, Pharmathen has grown to become one of the largest, vertically integrated developers of complex drug delivery technologies and is among the top 50 pharmaceutical research companies in Europe.

The company has one of the most extensive and advanced pipelines of long acting injectables (LAI), sustained release and ophthalmic formulations.

Pharmathen’s highly diversified portfolio consists of over 90 commercialized products, which are produced in its US FDA and EU-approved manufacturing facilities in Greece, serving 250 customers and accessed by patients in more than 90 countries worldwide.

Pharmathen proudly employs more than 1,600 people from over 28 different nationalities, with 54% of its total workforce and 66% of its Research Operations Team being female. The company’s enduring success is attributed to a passion for creativity, strong ethics, and the dedication of its people, who share a commitment to the company's vision of making a difference in people’s lives.

Due to continuous growth and expansion, Pharmathen Pharmaceuticals offers a great opportunity for career development and is seeking to recruit a Manufacturing Shift Team Leader for the Long Acting Injectables (LAI) Production team at our Sapes premises.

As a Manufacturing Shift Team Leader, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of manufacturing processes through the effective training, management, and development of your team. You will ensure that all activities are carried out in compliance with GMP standards.

More particularly:

  • In-room task assignments for all manufacturing employees of the specific shift to specific duties, based on their capabilities to ensure jobs are staffed with qualified people

Requirements

The ideal candidate should have:

  • College degree preferred B.Sc. Pharmacy or relevant to pharmaceutical industry

Minimum Experience

  • 3 - 5 years of team leading experience

Job-Specific Skills

  • Team management
  • Technical skills of aseptic area operations
  • CIP/SIP/Filling/Manufacturing/Autoclave operations

Benefits

What you'll gain:

  • Permanent housing allowance (for candidates outside region)
  • Relocation expenses coverage
  • Monthly vouchers
  • Private health insurance
  • Involvement in a high-caliber, team-oriented and dynamic atmosphere
  • Exposure to challenging business issues and practices
  • Great opportunity to leverage and develop your business knowledge and skills

Make the move that moves you forward!

Join our team and experience the unique Pharmathen’s culture that gives you the opportunity to innovate, to make decisions, to achieve your own potential and to chart your own career.

Pharmathen is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of gender, race, age, religion, sexual orientation, and national origin

title: Field Trainer - Germany
description:

Proven background in training and education, including:

Travel

title: Sr. Network Engineer, AI Infrastructure (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. NETWORK ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more.

As a Network Engineer you will drive the operation, build and deployment of the Starshield data center network, which supports critical national security missions. You and your teammates will own the network design and be responsible for proposing and implementing continual improvements to add more capabilities and customers. You will also be responsible for monitoring and improving network security, improving network performance and reliability, and optimizing network deployments.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage network infrastructure and deployments to Top Secret data centers
  • Design, validate, and productize high-speed copper and optical connectivity solutions for AI clusters (100k+ GPU scale)
  • Collaborate with ML training teams to translate workload communication patterns into concrete interconnect topology and optical reconfigurability requirements.
  • Contribute to various tools for rapid deployments (ZTP/custom provisioning tools)
  • Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics, including capacity planning, failure detection and remediation
  • Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments
  • Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers to improve the Starshield network design
  • Assist in updating system configuration and firmware
  • Build automation for network devices, operational and deployment tools
  • Mentor and train junior network engineers
  • As a senior engineer you must lead the team to technical excellence – your decisions guide the team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline AND 5+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks; OR 7+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions or cloud and web-scale networks in lieu of a degree
  • 5+ years of networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud and GPU networks (internship/co-op experience qualifies)
  • Layer-1 experience (e.g., transport, DWDM, optical fiber, circuit troubleshooting, activations, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with the deployment of networking hardware (routers, modems, switch, firewalls, etc..)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber
  • Deep understanding of datacenter networks including but not limited to:
    • Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)
    • Routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN)
    • Switching and routing
    • InfiniBand/NVLink
    • NVIDIA GPU deployment stacks (Blackwell/Rubin)
  • Experience implementing network security functions
  • Cisco, Juniper, Arista or other industry certification
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • Must be available for on-call rotations
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $165,000.00 - $270,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Licensed Independent Mental Health Practitioner (LIMHP)
description:
Licensed Independent Mental Health Practitioner (LIMHP)

Location: Nebraska
Position: Full-Time

title: Massachusetts Impaired Driving Educator (MID)
description:

The MID Instructor completes initial adult comprehensive assessments for program admission, mid-point evaluations, and exit interviews for each participant. Additionally, the instructor participates in ongoing curriculum development and provides documentation and consultation with probation officers, courts, and the Department of Motor Vehicles.

The MID Program is a 16-week educational program for individuals with a first DUI conviction. Participation is court-mandated, requiring attendance at sixteen 2-hour group sessions, a mid-point interview, and an exit interview.

Schedule: Fully remote / hours will be flexible

Payrate: $25 - $30 per hour, dependent on degree and licensure

Key Responsibilities

title: Head of Commercial, BESS
description:
About Relectrify

Relectrify is a Melbourne-based deep-tech company redefining how batteries connect to everything they power. Our CellSwitch® platform is an open architecture that works with any cell, built on more than 150 patents and roughly ten years of platform R&D, and backed by leading investors including Toyota, EDP, NRG Energy, GS and Australia's Clean Energy Finance Corporation.

The first product, the AC1, is designed for Commercial and Industrial (C&I) battery energy storage. It is now shipping, with ~A$45M of revenue expected across 2026-27 into a market we size at over A$25B/yr by 2030. We have moved from proving the technology to selling it, starting in Australia.

About the role

This newly created executive leadership position reports to the CEO and will be responsible for the commercial success of our battery energy storage systems (BESS) business. The Head of Commercial will own go-to-market strategy, business development, product marketing, solutions engineering and customer operations for our BESS product platform. The role is focused on the Australian market today, but the scope is global.

Who we need

We are a high-growth business, and our primary objective is to achieve market share leadership in our chosen market segments in Australia within 36 months. To do this, we need an experienced leader who has successfully led and scaled commercial teams, ideally within growth-stage product businesses in the energy sector. We need a leader with a proven track record who can define, refine and execute our go-to-market plan for success in both the commercial and industrial (C&I) and the front-of-the-meter (FTM) battery energy storage markets.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking ownership of delivering our ARENA programme, which underpins our Australian market entry with the AC1 product.
  • Refining our strategy and market positioning, including building partnerships with players in the market who can both benefit from and contribute to our success.
  • Owning our sales plan and our P&L, working with the CEO to define our targets and then delivering on these sales, revenue and gross profit numbers.
  • Defining, managing, and executing the right marketing plan for our BESS platform, including both brand building and demand generation.
  • Building and converting a pipeline of opportunities for the AC1 (and future products) through a combination of channel sales and key account business development.
  • Ensuring we deliver for customers by working with Production and Engineering leadership to build our project delivery, asset operations and customer success teams.
  • Thinking critically to identify better ways to deliver value to customers, including the exploration of novel product variants for specific use cases.
  • Working closely with our Product Management team to ensure that the true needs of the customer (and our competitive realities) are fully considered within our product roadmap.
  • Representing Relectrify in senior industry, customer and partner forums, communicating our vision and value proposition with credibility and impact at the executive level.
  • Working with the CEO and Chief of Staff to evaluate and develop the right approach to market entry in key global geographies, and leading these efforts once an entry decision is made.

Requirements

About you

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia and be willing to undergo pre-employment background checks (working rights, criminal history, and reference checks).

Must-have experience

  • Proven track record of successfully leading and scaling a go-to-market business, owning the commercial strategy, sales and financial results, and building the team to deliver them. Ideally, that experience will have been gained in a business that is:
    • a product business (rather than software or services);
    • a growth-stage company;
    • B2B-focused;
    • in the energy sector; and
    • in renewable energy or battery energy storage (BESS).
  • History of success building strategic partnerships with established players across the market.
  • Proven ability to close complex deals — developing pipeline through channel and key-account sales and winning competitive technical and commercial procurement processes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the credibility and presence to represent the company in senior industry, customer and external forums.

Compensation

The position offers market-competitive salary along with an incentive compensation scheme tied to our business development objectives. In addition, we offer the unique opportunity to participate directly in the ownership of Relectrify through our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).

Location

The position offers the flexibility of hybrid work between your home and our Melbourne office. Travel will be required from time to time.

Benefits

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Gender-neutral paid parental
  • Purchased leave scheme
  • Salary sacrifice for superannuation
  • Education reimbursement
  • No-cost commuting
  • Free snacks and (actually good!) coffee
  • Team events and monthly socials

We are located on the fringe of Melbourne CBD, within walking distance of Southern Cross, North Melbourne and Flagstaff stations.

Relectrify is committed to providing inclusive experiences. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, including: race, ethnicity, age, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, or disability. Discrimination based on these or any other social identities is not tolerated.

Note to recruitment agencies: Relectrify does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Relectrify does not pay placement fees for candidates submitted by any agency other than its approved partners.

title: Customer Experience Representative
description:
About PFM
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

About the department
Customer Experience is the front line of PFM. We're the team traders turn to when something isn't working, when they need clarity on a firm, a promotion, or their loyalty rewards, or when a payout question needs a real answer. We work across Intercom, Discord, and email to keep response times fast without losing quality and every ticket we close well is a small deposit in the trust traders place in PFM and in the firms we work with.

About the role
Deliver timely, accurate, and empathetic support that enables traders to confidently use Prop Firm Match while maintaining trust with both customers and partner firms. This role ensures every customer interaction contributes to a positive experience and protects the reputation of PFM.

Requirements

Performance objectives

Objective 1 - Deliver exceptional customer experience
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Respond to customer inquiries across Intercom tickets, Discord, and email.
  • Review and resolve customer issues end to end.
  • Tailor tone and approach to each customer's situation without sacrificing accuracy.

Success looks like
Customers receive accurate, professional, and empathetic support with high satisfaction.


Objective 2 - Maintain operational excellence
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Prioritize incoming tickets and follow established workflows.
  • Document cases and keep customer records up to date.
  • Escalate issues to the right team when they fall outside scope.

Success looks like
SLAs are consistently met while maintaining quality and minimizing escalations.

Objective 3 - Ensure information accuracy
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Verify offers, promo codes, and loyalty program submissions before responding.
  • Stay current on firm rules, payout information, and policies.
  • Keep FAQs and internal documentation accurate and current.

Success looks like
Customers receive consistent and up-to-date information regarding firms, promotions, loyalty rewards, and platform features.

Objective 4 - Support continuous improvement
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Report bugs and flag recurring issues to Product and Development.
  • Suggest workflow improvements based on patterns you notice.
  • Contribute to knowledge base updates and AI training data.

Success looks like
Customer feedback drives product and process improvements.


What we look for

Must have

  • Minimum 2 years of customer support or other client-facing experience, ideally in a remote, high-volume environment.
  • Strong written communication: able to explain things clearly and empathetically to non-technical customers.
  • Hands-on experience with Intercom or a similar helpdesk/ticketing platform.
  • High attention to detail: comfortable verifying specifics (promo codes, payout terms, policy language) before responding.
  • Strong time management, with the discipline to hit response-time and handling-time targets without cutting corners on quality.
  • Comfortable investigating and troubleshooting an issue independently before escalating it.
  • Professional, accountable, and collaborative: works well across teams without needing heavy oversight.
  • Available to work CET-aligned hours in a fully remote, async-first environment.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with proprietary trading firms or the prop trading industry.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support tools (e.g., Intercom Fin AI or similar) - kept here as a nice-to-have rather than dropped entirely, since it's still worth listing as a plus.
  • Experience managing or responding to public reviews (e.g., Trustpilot).
  • Background in fintech, SaaS, or another fast-paced digital consumer platform.

Compensation

  • up to $800 - $1,300 USD / month gross

Location & work setup

  • Remote, worldwide, with strong overlap with CET hours.
  • Employment type: Full-time.

Benefits

Hiring stages
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

  1. Application screening
    We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
  2. Video intro + role fit questionnaire
    A short async step - no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
  3. Discovery HR Interview
    A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match - how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
  4. Real-world task
    A short, scoped exercise based on real PFM support scenarios, giving both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
  5. Professional interview
    A conversation with the Head of Customer Experience focused on your support experience, problem-solving approach, and how you handle real user situations - including firm-comparison neutrality and integrity judgment calls.
  6. Peer & values conversation
    A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

Before applying take into account that:
▸ If you don’t meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires - we encourage you to apply.
▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
▸ Even if it’s not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.

Not the right fit for this role?
If this role isn’t the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area - we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

title: Network Engineer, AI Infrastructure (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NETWORK ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more.

As a Network Engineer you will drive the operation, build and deployment of the Starshield data center network, which supports critical national security missions. You and your teammates will own the network design and be responsible for proposing and implementing continual improvements to add more capabilities and customers. You will also be responsible for monitoring and improving network security, improving network performance and reliability, and optimizing network deployments.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage network infrastructure and deployments to Top Secret data centers
  • Design, validate, and productize high-speed copper and optical connectivity solutions for AI clusters (100k+ GPU scale)
  • Collaborate with ML training teams to translate workload communication patterns into concrete interconnect topology and optical reconfigurability requirements.
  • Contribute to various tools for rapid deployments (ZTP/custom provisioning tools)
  • Improve network performance and reliability based upon system performance metrics, including capacity planning, failure detection and remediation
  • Assist in capacity augmentation and network optimization deployments
  • Lead network integration and troubleshooting efforts
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and network engineers to improve the Starshield network design
  • Assist in updating system configuration and firmware
  • Build automation for network devices, operational and deployment tools

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline; OR 4+ years of professional networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud and web-scale networks in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ year of networking experience deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud and GPU networks (internship/co-op experience qualifies)
  • Layer-1 experience (e.g., transport, DWDM, optical fiber, circuit troubleshooting, activations, etc.)
  • Hands on experience with the deployment of networking hardware (routers, modems, switch, firewalls, etc..)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline
  • Experience with physical troubleshooting of fiber
  • Deep understanding of datacenter networks including but not limited to:
    • Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)
    • Routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN)
    • Switching and routing
    • InfiniBand/NVLink
    • NVIDIA GPU deployment stacks (Blackwell/Rubin)
  • Experience implementing network security functions
  • Cisco, Juniper, Arista or other industry certification
  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • Must be available for on-call rotations
  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: 3rd Shift Direct Care
description:
Position Summary

The Residential Recovery Specialist (RRS) supports residents in a safe, structured, and trauma-informed environment. This role helps residents follow their individualized treatment plans, engages them in recovery and relapse prevention, and assists with daily living tasks such as meal prep, housekeeping, and transportation. The RRS plays a vital role in fostering a supportive, recovery-focused community.

Pay Rate: $19 - $21 an hour

Open Shift: Tuesday through Saturday 11pm-7am (40hrs)

  • Ability to build supportive community in a diverse residential setting.
  • Must be able to pass and maintain certifications in MAP, CPR, and First Aid.

title: Craft Safety Technician

Paradigm Power Delivery, a Babcock Power company, is a company whose mission is to build electrical substations and construct or repair electrical power lines while providing high quality, efficient service to our customers, and a safe, healthy work environment for our employees. About Integration & Community Living (ICL)

The Integration & Community Living (ICL) program supports individuals with developmental disabilities and brain injuries in living independently and meaningfully in the community. title: Senior Director of Program Strategy and Performance
description:
Living Resources is a non-profit agency dedicated to empowering individuals with disabilities or other life-altering conditions to live with dignity, independence, and purpose. We work with, and for, families by providing peace of mind. All employees are to be respectful and supportive of families. We are working with them as partners, providing support and services.


To work for Living Resources is to make a difference in the lives of others. Living Resources employees provide individuals with disabilities and other life-altering conditions the support they need to thrive and lead active, full lives. For many employees, their work becomes an experience where they find fulfillment and develop both personally and professionally.


Our Values

Advocacy, Collaboration, Empowerment, Excellence, Inclusivity, Integrity, and Kindness are at the heart of everything we do. These values guide how we support those we serve, work together, and create a culture where everyone can thrive.


The Senior Director of Program Strategy and Performance serves as a strategic partner to the Chief Program Officer, helping to advance organizational priorities and strengthen program performance. The position uses operational, programmatic, and financial data to identify opportunities, address performance concerns, and ensure programs align with strategic, regulatory, fiscal, and person-centered expectations.

Working collaboratively across Program Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Quality Assurance, Compliance, Billing/Revenue Cycle, Information Technology, Intake, and Executive Leadership, the Senior Director translates strategic priorities into actionable plans, measurable objectives, and sustainable results. The position also analyzes the program operational factors that influence financial performance and provides programmatic information to support Finance-led budgeting, forecasting, billing, reimbursement, and financial analysis.


Strategic Planning and Execution:

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief Program Officer in advancing organizational and departmental priorities.
  • Translate strategic program priorities into actionable plans, timelines, deliverables, measurable objectives, and accountability structures.
  • Monitor progress, identify barriers, recommend solutions, and evaluate the effectiveness of strategic initiatives.
  • Support organizational change and help program leaders translate strategic decisions into operational practice.

Program Performance and Improvement:

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to program quality, census, capacity, utilization, staffing, referrals, productivity, and service delivery.
  • Analyze program performance, identify trends and areas of concern, and work with program leaders to develop and monitor improvement plans.
  • Analyze program staffing and resource needs based on census, utilization, service needs, and operational requirements, and provide recommendations to the CPO and program leadership.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve service delivery, operational efficiency, resource allocation, and program sustainability.

Operational and Financial Program Analytics:

  • Partner with Finance and program leadership to understand program budgets, financial expectations, and the relationship between program operations and financial performance.
  • Analyze the operational factors affecting program revenue and expenses, including census, vacancies, staffing, overtime, service delivery, documentation, authorizations, and utilization.
  • In collaboration with Finance, review program-level financial trends and identify the operational factors contributing to significant variances.
  • Monitor program documentation, service delivery, authorizations, and utilization, and collaborate with Finance and Billing/Revenue Cycle to address issues that may affect billing or reimbursement.
  • Provide programmatic, staffing, utilization, and capacity information to support Finance-led budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial analysis.
  • Help program leaders understand how operational decisions and performance affect departmental budgets and overall financial results. ·

Data Analytics and Reporting:

  • Develop program operational dashboards and reports that measure program performance, staffing, census, capacity, utilization, referrals, and other key indicators.
  • Partner with Finance and Information Technology to improve the accuracy, consistency, accessibility, and usefulness of organizational data.
  • Work with Finance to appropriately connect operational activity with validated financial information.
  • Identify trends, risks, and emerging concerns through data analysis and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Prepare briefing materials, presentations, dashboards, and analyses for the Chief Program Officer, Executive Leadership, and Board of Directors, ensuring that financial information is reviewed and validated by Finance.

Program Growth and Organizational Capacity:

  • Analyze opportunities for program growth, expansion, restructuring, consolidation, or redesign and provide recommendations to the CPO and Executive Leadership.
  • Develop or contribute to the operational and programmatic components of business cases for new programs, service expansions, and program modifications.
  • Provide Finance with programmatic, staffing, utilization, and capacity assumptions to support its evaluation of financial feasibility and sustainability.
  • Collaborate with Intake and program leadership to monitor referral pipelines, vacancies, admissions, and utilization of available capacity. · Identify opportunities to strengthen the organization’s response to referrals and appropriately improve program census and utilization.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration, Compliance and Executive Support:

  • Facilitate assigned cross-departmental initiatives and collaborate with Program Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Quality Assurance, Compliance, Intake, Billing/Revenue Cycle, and Information Technology.
  • Serve as a liaison between Program Operations and Finance by helping program leaders understand financial expectations and helping Finance understand the operational factors affecting financial results.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Compliance to ensure that program operations and improvement initiatives support regulatory requirements, quality, health and safety, person-centered services, and the rights of people supported.
  • Support program readiness for regulatory reviews, audits, surveys, and other oversight activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Compliance, and program leadership.
  • Provide the Chief Program Officer with timely operational analysis and recommendations and report on the progress of strategic priorities.
  • Represent the Chief Program Officer on designated committees and projects and lead special initiatives as assigned.

title: Program Manager - Operations, Andhra Pradesh
description:
About Mitti Labs

Mitti Labs is a climate-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.

Backed by NASA-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net-zero goals through verified, high-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.

Our customers - including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri-businesses - trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.

Role Description

Mitti Labs is currently working with 10,000 farmers across different regions in AP. We need a strong state lead or project lead to manage the execution of carbon process-related and input sales related tasks in our project regions across the State.

Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.

Some of your objectives will include:

  • Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre-defined roadmap
  • Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
  • Continually training, re-training, and supporting the field agent force
  • Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?

We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. External Partner Operations Management

  • Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
  • Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
  • Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
  • Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc.
  • Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner’s teams (at managerial and operational levels)
  • Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks

2. Internal Communications

  • Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
  • Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
  • Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
  • Offer support on Science Ops, R&D ops, agronomic demos, etc.

3. Operational Execution and Leadership

  • Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on-ground execution
  • Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
  • Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
  • Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
  • Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
  • Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
  • Build marketing material in coordination with on-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
  • Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs + Video walkthroughs

Requirements

Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:

  • Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
  • Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
  • Experience in Agri Project Management
  • Strong communication skills and composure when dealing with large scale projects and large teams
  • Process excellence mindset
  • People management. High cultural sensitivity and ability to motivate rural teams.
  • Ability to pre-empt issues and offer solutions to fire-fight
  • Willingness to travel to fields on daily basis
  • Ability to understand and engage with agrarian communities, understanding of farmers, FPOs, NGOs, Government Departments, etc...

Experience:

  • Strong professional experience (7+ years) - ideally in agri-project management, field extension management, input distribution/sales
  • Category experience in Paddy farming is strongly preferred
  • Proven experience in optimizing processes and building systems and strategies to support scale
  • Strong educational background, preferably in Agribusiness management, Field Extension management, operations / supply chain strategy type roles
  • Experience managing large field teams (100–300 people) through partner organizations or direct teams.
  • Demonstrated capability in building high-performance cultures, coaching mid-level managers, and creating accountability systems.
  • Strong ability to create MIS, and monitor KPIs at scale.
  • Hands-on experience using project management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, Excel, Looker Studio, etc.).
  • Experience in multi-district or multi-state program rollouts.
  • Prior experience implementing QA/QC frameworks, audits, field validation checks, and adherence to SOP.
  • Experience in generating detailed stakeholder-specific reports and documentation to synthesize findings and learnings to diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience ensuring compliance with carbon methodologies, government schemes, donor requirements, or agri certification programs.
  • Native fluency in Telugu is a must

Benefits

Purpose driven work - tackling the worlds most pressing challenges - climate change, food security, water security, farmer livelihoods improvement.

Culture / Team / Environment - our team includes the best minds in science, product, business and operations, in an environment where collaboration and openness is highly valued, unbiased, objective decision making, direct relationship with founders, and encouragement of career growth in a rapidly scaling organization.

Exposure to multiple stakeholders - internal and external, ability to operate at the center of the organization.
